articleTitle: A Developed Deep Learning-based Approach for Microorganism Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Infections from microorganisms have become a significant threat to the growth and even life of the world in the past few decades. Most microorganisms pose a low-level danger to human life because they can spread through food, water, or the air. Every day, under normal conditions, this can lead to thousands of deaths worldwide. So, quickly and accurately classifying microorganisms is very important for things like clinical diagnosis, food safety, soil research, public health, and so on. By running processes directly on microscopic images, deep learning-based classification methods can correctly speed up identifying microorganisms. In this study, a developed approach for classifying microorganisms is suggested. In addition to the recommended way, five modern deep-learning approaches (Densenet201, Mobilenetv2, Resnet152v2, Inceptionresnetv2, and Nasnetlarge) are trained and tested on the collected microorganism dataset with and without data augmentation. The suggested approach worked better, with a F1-Score of 98%, a Precision of 98%, a Recall of 97%, and an Accuracy of 98.9473%.

articleTitle: Digital Creative Product Design based on Hyper Parameter Tuned Deep Convolutional Neural Network using Artificial Intelligence Images
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) image generation techniques have proved to be potential techniques in the development of the digital creative product design. However, integrating digital culture with modernity while classifying AI image generation technology was a major concern. In this research, the hyper parameter tuned Deep Convolutional Neural Network with Stochastic Gradient (DCNN-SGD) is proposed to overcome these drawbacks, by classifying $A I$ images of product design. The open source AI images are collected and pre-processed to achieve noise free images by applying Gaussian filter. The pre-processed images are then fed to the CNN to extract features. The creative product design process is analysed which includes research and analysis, design expression and the final evaluation. The DCNN with convolutional, pooling and fully connected layers are used for the classification and identification of cultural symbols. For the effective identification of cultural heritage, the hyperparameters of the DCNN are finetuned with SGD. The experimental results showed that the proposed DCNN-SGD achieved better performance with classification accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 6 7 \%}$, precision of $\mathbf{9 5. 7 7 \%}$, and recall of $94.26 \%$ when compared to the existing methods improved Backpropagation Neural Network (BPNN) and Artificial Neural Network (ANN).

articleTitle: Research on Heart Disease Detection using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Heart disease is one of the significant diseases that lead to health complications, and eventually mortality. The recognition and management of cardiac disease is intricate, particularly in developing countries, because of the limited accessibility of effective diagnostic instruments. Also, the primary elements include insufficient preventative measures and the shortage of experienced medical experts leads to severe issues. Even though a significant number of cardiac disorders are prevented, they still increase because of insufficient preventive efforts. Various researchers have built several clinical decision support systems for predicting cardiac illness to streamline and optimize diagnosis in the modern digital age. This study examines the current status of several clinical decision support systems for predicting cardiac disease, which have been developed by various researchers using machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) methodologies. Consequently, the development of classification models for heart disease has only achieved an intermediate level of success. Hence, there is a requirement for intricate models that integrate various data sources from different geographic locations to enhance the accuracy of disease forecasting.

articleTitle: Data Protection in Cloud Computing Environment: New Dimension of Network Information Security
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Against the backdrop of continuous development of computer technology, the service scope of the network system is constantly expanding, and the service capability is significantly improving to meet the growing material and spiritual needs of the people. However, the issue of network information security has become more prominent, especially in environments such as public security systems that require extremely high security requirements. This article delved into the key challenges and solutions for data protection in cloud computing environments, with a focus on analyzing the application effects of symmetric and asymmetric encryption technologies in improving network information security, especially their application in public security systems. Through systematic literature review and empirical analysis, theoretical support and practical guidance were provided for further strengthening and optimizing network security measures in the public security system. The experimental results showed that for a 20MB data file, RSA had an encryption time of about 6400 milliseconds and a decryption time of about $\mathbf{6 2 0 0}$ milliseconds, revealing that asymmetric encryption technology may affect performance when processing big data and requires a balance between security and performance.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction in Intelligent Transportation using Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolution Attention Module
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The timely and accurate traffic flow prediction is critical for stable and safe Intelligent Transportation System (ITS). Due to the nonlinearity and difficulty of traffic, the existing techniques unable to capture local and global correlations. The Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolution Attention Module (STGCAM) is proposed for capture dynamic correlations among spatial and temporal networks. The PeMS04 and PeMS08 dataset is used which composed 3848 and 1979 detectors. The STGCAM is used to estimate the attention weights for every timestep in sequence of input. The graph convolutional operation collects every node feature with adjacent node when CBAM build adaptive corrections to attain node features. The STGCAM performance is calculated by Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) for PeMS04 and PeMS08 datasets. The STGCAM attains 11.65% and 8.37% of MAPE for PeMS04 and PeMS08 dataset correspondingly when compared to existing mechanisms such as Global Spatio-Temporal Dynamic Capturing Network (GSTDCN), and Dynamic Graph Spatial-Temporal Neural Network (DGSTN).

articleTitle: Evaluation of Agricultural Modernization Development Level based on Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis and Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Recent days, agricultural modernization represents a transformative shift from traditional farming practices to a modern, science-driven agricultural system. The existing approaches for assessing agricultural modernization development level have encountered significant challenges which includes, model interoperability, identification of patterns and relationships, variability in temporal and spatial variables. Therefore, this paper proposes Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis-Backpropagation Neural Network (ESDABPNN) for Evaluation of Agricultural Modernization Development Level which is employed on statistical yearbook of Chinese government. Then, the data is preprocessed by using data normalization which effectively improved the model interoperability. After that, the ESDA-BPNN is used for analyzing the agricultural development which effectively identified the patterns and relationships between neighboring regions, highlighted the areas of high agricultural modernization. Finally, obstacle degree model is used for identifying key constraints and quantifies the obstacle impact. The proposed ESDA has increased in the year 2024 C 1 has increased 22%, C2 increased 24%, C3 increased 25%, C4 increases 22% and C5 increases 24%, where, C1, C2, C3, C4 and C 5 are per unit arable machinery, irrigation rate, per capita electricity consumption, agriculture results of expenditure, area of arable land per household when compared with existing ESDA.

Author Keywords: evaluation of agricultural modernization development level

articleTitle: Generative Pre-Trained Transformer-4 based on English Assistant Teaching System in Higher Vocational Colleges
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Nowadays, globalization accelerates the growing demand for English proficiency among students in numerous ways, technical and professional education including business, engineering, healthcare, vocational institutions and technology. In this, effective communication is essential for interactive multimedia and in any conference different types of language speaking people attends and the communication with no proper language can misguide the process. Therefore, this paper proposes Generative Pre-Trained Transformer (GPT-4) for personalized feedback and interactive communication in real-time with vocational field. Firstly, personalized guidance for customized grammar and vocabulary differentiate truthful and incorrect statements when the person communicated through English language in any professional field. This segment of text with passages provides feedback on comprehension for unstructured data in higher vocational field. Then, this feedback response for real-time feedback generated data split into pieces or documents for assistant teaching is followed by data validation. After that, these documents differentiate incorrect statements in communicated way throughout the world in interactive sessions and providing detailed feedback. The proposed GPT-4 for English assistant teaching system achieved better results in terms of accuracy, precision, recall and F1-Score when compared to GPT-3.

articleTitle: Improved Mask Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network for Remote Sensing Landslide Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Remote sensing has become an essential tool in detecting landslides, as it enables efficient assessment of huge areas. Insufficient training data, class imbalance, and complexities in extracting relevant features are some of the challenges that existing methods face. A new approach is worked in the proposed method to address these issues by combining data augmentation, semantic segmentation through DeepLabV3+, and detection accelerated by Improved Mask Recurrent Convolutional Neural Network (RCNN). The Landslide detector dataset is applied to make significant advancements in the proposed method, resulting in an accuracy of 97.34%, precision of 96.78%, and recall of 95.59%. Faster RCNN, Digital Elevation Model-CNN (DEM-CNN), Distance Domain Transfer Learning (DDTL), and Automated Landslide Detection Model (ALDM) cannot be best by this technique due to its limitations. The proposed method, of this paper aims to improve the accuracy and reliability of landslide detection in remote sensing applications by enhancing the segmentation and detection process.

articleTitle: Application of Multimodal Data Fusion in Intelligent Content Recommendation System for New Media Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern information technology, social media has gradually penetrated into the daily lives of billions of people worldwide, changing people’s communication patterns. In the face of massive information overload, personalized content recommendation is an important way to solve the problem of user churn. This article explores a new social media content recommendation method that uses multimodal data fusion technology to filter and match user preferences and content features, greatly improving user experience and enhancing platform stickiness and commercial value. The experimental results show that the recommendation system using multimodal data fusion technology is significantly better than traditional methods in terms of recommendation accuracy, user satisfaction, and platform interaction rate, with a recommendation accuracy rate of $70 \%$. The research in this article has important theoretical and practical significance for promoting the development of information technology and improving the service quality of social media platforms.

articleTitle: Copy-Move Forgery Detection using Random Opposition based Learning-Artificial Hummingbird Image Processing Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Copy-Move Forgery Detection (CMFD) is particular type of tampering image where an image part is copied and pasted in another image to determine a significant feature. Therefore, an aim in detecting copy-move forgeries is for detecting an area of image which are enormously same. However, accurately detecting these forgeries is challenging particularly in noise and subtle manipulation which results in suboptimal performance. In this research, the Random Opposition Based Learning-Artificial Hummingbird Approach (ROBL-AHA) is proposed for CMFD. In AHA, ROBL is incorporated to balance the exploitation which helps to minimize the convergence speed and avoids local optima issue. Initially, the image is taken from the standard dataset using MICC-F2000 to analyse the model performance. ScaleInvariant Feature Transform (SIFT) is applied for extracting a distinct keypoints from an image which remain invariant to variations based on rotation, noise, and scaling. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is used for accurately detecting the forgeries. The proposed ROBL-AHA achieves a better accuracy of $\mathbf{9 9. 7 6 \%}$ compared to existing methods like Mask Regionbased CNN and Grasshopper Optimization Approach (GOA) with Spotted Hyena Optimizer (SOA) using MICC-F2000 dataset.

Author Keywords: random opposition based learningartificial hummingbird approach

articleTitle: LSTM Neural Network Intelligent Power Load Based on TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: With the growth of global energy demand and the widespread use of renewable energy, how to accurately predict power demand has become a key issue to ensure the stability of the power grid and optimize energy distribution. The application of TensorFlow-based LSTM neural network in intelligent power load research mainly focuses on improving the accuracy and efficiency of power demand prediction. In this study, the LSTM model based on the TensorFlow framework is used to predict power demand. Through training on historical load data, the model learns the timing characteristics of power demand in order to achieve more accurate predictions. The research results show that the accuracy rate of the LSTM model based on the TensorFlow framework is above 94.15%, and the highest accuracy rate is 95.78%. Experimental data show that the system significantly improves the accuracy of prediction. The LSTM model has wide application potential in the future development of smart grids and power systems, and can provide strong technical support for the reliable operation of the power grid and the efficient use of energy.

articleTitle: A Novel Big Data Algorithm of Data Visualization and Generation Adversarial Network Fusion for International Trade
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: When using the traditional method to evaluate the international trade capacity, there is a problem of poor evaluation accuracy. To this end, the international trade big data algorithm of data visualization and generation confrontation network fusion is proposed. The fuzzy evaluation theory is used to establish the evaluation factor set of data visualization and generation confrontation network fusion, calculate the weight of each factor, and obtain the ratio of the weight of each factor. The international trade big data algorithm is used to study the fusion of data visualization and generating adversarial network, and combined with the gray theory to calculate the evaluation rate of data visualization and generated adversarial network fusion, to complete the research of data visualization and generated adversarial network fusion. According to the simulation experiment results, the proposed method can effectively improve the effectiveness and reliability of data visualization and generation adversarial network (GAN) fusion capability evaluation.

articleTitle: FOPID based Feed-Forward Temperature Control of a 100°C Thermal Reservoir
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This study explores the effectiveness of a Fractional-Order Proportional-Integral-Derivative (FOPID) controller combined with feed-forward control (FFC) for temperature regulation in thermal reservoirs, focusing on systems subject to dynamic disturbances. The thermal reservoir is modeled using a first-order transfer function, and the effects of external disturbances on temperature stability are examined. The FOPID controller presents fractional-order dynamics, enhancing system tuning and performance. Simulations demonstrate the use a fractional integral order of 0.8 resulted in a settling time of 21 seconds, a 40% improvement over traditional PID controllers, which settled in 35 seconds. Furthermore, the overshoot has been minimized to 5%, and temperature deviations maintained at $\pm 2^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ of the setpoint during disturbances. The integration of FFC allows to emit disturbances, significantly improving system responsiveness. This research highlights the advantages of FOPID and FFC in achieving precise and efficient temperature control as a valuable approach for enhancing thermal management systems.

articleTitle: Charging Pile Load Forecasting using Long Short-Term Memory and Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Nowadays, the development of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is probably leading to threaten the power system. As new EV gain popularity, cities are increasingly focusing on installing EV charging infrastructure. But, forecasting the demand for charging stations is one of the serious issues facing while mitigating growth of $\mathbf{E V}$ infrastructure, caused by the increase of diffusion of EVs. RNN (Recurrent Neural Network) makes difficulty to learn long-term dependencies in charging load patterns. To overcome these issues of load forecasting, the method of Long Short-Term Memory and Recurrent Neural Network (LSTM-RNN) is proposed to predicts the charging demand at the certain point of charging. Also, it ensures accurate forecasts and optimized energy management with infrastructure planning for EV. For the analysis, the proposed LSTM-RNN employs with a two-stage data preprocessing technique on charging load dataset. Then the refined data is fed into the load forecasting which predicts charging power requirements to optimize charging schedules and ensure reliable with efficient energy supply. The proposed LSTM-RNN presents greater results than the existing methods of Enhanced Attention-Based Long Short-term Memory (EA-LSTM) on load forecasting of charging pile in terms of MAE (0.987), RMSE (8.345) and $R^{2}(0.986)$ respectively.

Author Keywords: long short-term memory and recurrent neural network

articleTitle: A Patient Response Prediction System using Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Semantic Segmentation Network and Med-YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Nowadays, most of the people are getting affected with various health issues such as typhoid, diabetes and cancer. A human immune system plays a crucial role in maintaining and balancing human health and reduces the risk of getting ill. Immunotherapy is a treatment which utilizes human body immunity power to fight cancer. There are many challenges in the existing models such as imbalance data, heterogenic data, uncertainties, and lack of temporal data. These challenges are resolved by imposing deep learning techniques and generating a valid information with the clinical details of patient health conditions. Therefore, a hybrid model name called Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Semantic Segmentation Network (MSSNet) and You Look Only Once (MedYOLO) for feature extraction and detection. Initially, Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE) is employed to overcome the issue of imbalanced data; further MSSNet is imposed for extracting the optimal features and detected using MedYOLO. Also, to get detailed information and generate cohort, the data collected from GSC hospital with overall details that are essential to predict the patient response to immunotherapy in cancer treatment. In the end, MSSNet-MedYOLO obtained higher accuracy of 98.16% for an effective prediction of patient response which is better than existing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN).

Author Keywords: multi-scale feature fusion semantic segmentation network

articleTitle: Autonomous Navigating Robo for Personal Assistance
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The potential of the Autonomous Navigating Robo for Personal Assistance (ANRPA) to transform human robot interactions is the reason for its selection. The combination of hand gesture control, autonomous navigation with obstacle avoidance and live streaming answers the demand for robotic systems that are easy to operate. This work develops a robot that navigates autonomously and responds dynamically to hand gestures, making it a personal assistant. This work aims to create an interactive robot capable of navigation through (i) User maps enabling the robot to get around different landscapes autonomously. (ii) Gesture control, here robot interprets hand gestures to react to changes in its environment, ensuring smooth operations even in unforeseen situations. The ANRPA provides a solution that combines autonomous and human-controlled navigation. Map driven navigation capability is created utilizing path planning algorithms that process input maps and drive the robot to its destination with an accuracy of $\pm 5 \mathrm{~cm}$.These algorithms translate precise motions into equivalent robotic operations.

articleTitle: A Deep Learning Framework for Diagnosing and Predicting Knee Osteoarthritis Utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Knee osteoarthritis (KOA) is a degenerative disorder that significantly impacts mobility and diminishes the overall quality of life, particularly in individuals who are obese. The disease progression is exacerbated by inflammatory processes involving cytokines and metabolic factors. The irreversible damage caused by KOA often leads to the necessity for total knee replacement (TKR), a procedure that is expensive and has a limited lifespan. Current diagnostic methods heavily rely on manual segmentation and annotation of X-ray images, which are labor-intensive and prone to observer variability. This research proposes a deep learning framework that employs Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to automate the classification of knee X-ray images, enhancing the early and accurate detection of KOA. The Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grading scale is the most widely accepted method for predicting the severity of KOA based on radiographic evidence from knee X-rays. The dataset utilized in this study comprises $\mathbf{1, 8 0 0}$ digital X-ray images obtained from the global hospitals and diagnostic centers, captured using the PROTEC PRS 500E X-ray machine. Our CNN model achieved a high diagnostic accuracy, demonstrating its potential for practical clinical use. The CNN model undergoes extensive training and validation to achieve high diagnostic accuracy, followed by its integration into a webbased application developed with the Flask framework. This deep learning framework employing CNN frameworks enhances the accuracy of diagnosing and classifying knee osteoarthritis severity, improving early detection, clinical efficiency, and patient outcomes.

articleTitle: An Effective Analysis of Customer Satisfaction with Retail Sales Services
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Analyzing retail sales data is essential for enhancing the product sales rate and helps to maintain trust between retailers and customers. Various existing methods employed strategies to increase customer satisfaction but failed to achieve significant results due to improper analysis of retail sales factors. Analyzing collected online shopping data is crucial for optimizing retail sales. The personalized experience, business-to-business (B2B), and add-on benefit factors are the hypotheses considered for the evaluation of the relationship between the consumers and the retailer. These hypotheses play a key role in analyzing customer satisfaction towards retail sales. These factors greatly influence the customer’s interest in the products. Retailers must offer additional benefits to earn customer trust. The validation and reliability of these hypotheses were evaluated, yielding Cronbach’s Alpha scores of of 0.924 for personalized experience, 0.914 for $B 2 B$, and 0.949 for add-on benefits. The analysis of customer satisfaction toward retail sales has obtained a minimum error of 0.359 for Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) and $\mathbf{0. 6 1 9}$ for Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE) compared to the existing analysis.

articleTitle: The Application of the Integration of the Internet of Things and Palm Print Recognition Algorithm in the Mobile Third-Party Payment Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Mobile third-party payment platform can rapidly promote the realization of the Internet of things, and the current mobile third-party payment risk prediction results deviation larger problems, so this paper puts forward the Internet of things and palm print recognition algorithm fusion of mobile third-party payment platform risk prediction in-depth research. In view of the problems existing in the data sample of the mobile third-party payment platform, the risk prediction of mobile third-party payment is taken as the entry point, and the analysis means are completed through feature selection, unbalanced sample processing and the integration of the Internet of Things, and the risk prediction of mobile third-party payment. The experimental results show that the proposed method in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy of risk prediction of mobile third-party payment platform and has certain use value, and the risk prediction of mobile third-party payment through big data and deep learning algorithm has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Automatic Electrical Equipment Control System using Non-Stationary Markov Chain Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In these days, electrical equipment control systems are playing a major role in various industries including power plants, distribution systems and renewable energies. The optimizations techniques are utilized for the electrical equipment control including the existing Markov Chain Optimization (MCO) technique have limitations. The existing MCO technique gives inefficient failures as it assumes that the previous transitions are always constant. In this paper, Non-Stationary Markov Chain (NSMC) optimization technique is proposed for the automatic electric equipment control system. Initially, the optimization technique started with state variable initialization with time parameter as it improves the reliability of state variable sequence. Then, the transition probability and sojourn for each state is calculated by using transition probability and the transition states are recognized as functional and failure states. After that, the transition states are evaluated and the matrix approach is utilized to find the time duration taken for the failure in each state. The transition matrix helps electrical equipment system to operate smoothly and ensures the reliability by predicting the failures. From the results, the proposed NSMC optimization model provided better results than the existing CAD-IOMPSE by providing results in terms of accuracy (89.46%), recall (88.43%) and F1-score (90.64%) respectively.

articleTitle: An Auxiliary Fine-tuning Transformer for HumanObject Interaction Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The detection of human-object interactions (HOI) can be approached through two primary methods: two-stage and one-stage approaches. Two-stage methods involve dividing the task into object detection and interaction classification, which, although effective, still face several challenges. In this paper, we propose a novel Fine-Tuning Transformer (FFT) to address these challenges within a one-stage framework. FFT introduces a new module that assists the decoder in identifying the most relevant HOI pairs in an image. Additionally, we introduce a reweighting method to tackle the issue of long-tail distribution. Our method incorporates various enhancements and has demonstrated improved accuracy, achieving state-of-the-art results on the HICO-DET and VCOCO datasets.

articleTitle: Pretive Role and Recommendations of Time Series Data Based on REF-RF
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The paper mainly focuses on the analysis and prediction of time series data. One of the main characteristics of time series data is that it usually contains trends and patterns, which are relatively hard to measure and predict accurately. Therefore, we set up a reasonable and accurate model based on a specific dataset. The quantitative model predicts outcomes under differences in key time series indicators. Missing value imputation, outliers handling, and normalization of data are performed through data preprocessing using Box Plots, BP Neural Network Algorithms, and Dimensionless Quantification before trying to solve the problem. The impact of various factors on time series data is modeled in the first part of this study. After that, dimensionality reduction for each influencing factor was done using the RFE-RF algorithm. Then, Entropy-TOPSIS should be run to express the size of impact. In this step, consider the weight of each indicator as the standard score in order to get an evaluation with respect to the importance of various factors due to the time series data. Finally, Plotting the data by making a line chart of the level difference of key indicators against time using Python. We applied the model to additional datasets to assess its accuracy. Subsequently, to check and validate this model, we implemented a Decision Tree and afterward applied regression to further fine-tune the model by its prediction.

articleTitle: Smart City Image Recognition Method Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In the new period, with the continuous development of society, urban management should also keep pace with the times, take the initiative to learn new ideas, introduce new technologies, and innovate and optimize in the management mode and management content in order to better adapt to the needs of modern urban construction. To this end, the competent authorities must pay close attention to the latest technology, in particular the use of “5G+Big Data”, in order to achieve the ultimate goal of automated and intelligent management by means of a variety of information technology tools, thereby promoting the modernization of cities. Based on this, this paper conducts research on the application of 5G+big data in smart city management, which has important theoretical and practical significance. In smart city case recognition, the object detection method is able to accurately determine the category of an object based on its different characteristics through repeated learning, which is important in common cases such as illegal parking of vehicles and illegal posting of advertisements. In this paper, a novel object detection method based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is presented and evaluated. The improved U-Net (Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation) network performs excellently in semantic segmentation tasks, with an average accuracy of 91.4%, while the CLRNet-L (Cross layer Refined Network with Large Kernel Attention for Object Detection) network performs well in object detection, with an average accuracy of 93.5% and processing speed that meets real-time monitoring requirements. The experimental results show that the model introduced in this paper achieves efficient and accurate detection and classification in smart city image recognition, which has a wide application potential.

articleTitle: Cloud based Student Employment Recommendation Platform using Opposition-based Learning with Skill Optimization Algorithm and Multi-Layer Perceptron
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: With the help of computer technology, the English teaching has achieved improvements gradually through internet. This research builds a student employment recommendation platform based on Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and attains personalized recommendation through cloud computing. The Opposition-Based Learning with Skill Optimization Algorithm and Multi-Layer Perceptron (OBLSOA-MLP) is proposed in this research for student employment recommendation platform. The OBLSOA helps to reduce the correlation between features thereby improving the feature selection step and creating a model with fewer interpretations. This simplified feature selection contributes positively on computational performance and enhances the quality of the recommendations. This work provides MLP to high relevance to a flexibly developing platform that help students during their job search and enhance their possibilities. The collected data is preprocessed by normalization which normalize the data in the range of 0 and 1. The recall, accuracy, f-measure and precision are estimated for OBLSOA-MLP performance. The MLP obtains 0.953 recall, 0.978 accuracy, 0.947 f -measure and 0.921 precision which is better than existing methods.

articleTitle: Methods for Evaluating the Translation Quality of Artificial Intelligence Translator DEEPL Based on Multi Translation Parallel Corpus
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: With the acceleration of globalization and the development of information technology, the demand for cross linguistic communication is increasing day by day. The existing translation quality assessment methods have limitations in terms of accuracy and efficiency in evaluating large-scale data multilingual pairs. This article evaluated the translation quality of the artificial intelligence translator DeepL based on a multi translation parallel corpus. A multi translation parallel corpus based evaluation method was studied, which evaluated translation quality by comparing the similarity between DeepL translation results and the original text of multiple translation versions. The experimental results show that the method studied in this article has the highest similarity in Chinese translation for English, Russian, and French, reaching 98.7%, 98.9%, and 97.8%, respectively. The conclusion indicates that the DEEPL translation quality evaluation method based on multi translation parallel corpora can achieve accurate and efficient evaluation, which helps to improve multi-dimensional evaluation of translation quality.

articleTitle: Optimizing Security in OBS: Implementation and Evaluation of Modified SHA-160 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: OBS is a technology with the potential to meet the increasing network demands. However, due to its dynamic nature, ensuring security is still a challenge. The objective of the proposed work is to tackle the vulnerabilities in OBS networks by identifying security risks and recommending improved security measures. Moreover, the proposed work introduces a methodology for a fast SHA-160 authentication algorithm. The proposed algorithm is put into effect on a COTS FPGA utilizing the Xilinx ISE 14.6 platform and a VIRTEX 7 synthesis model. The results indicate that the proposed SHA-1 design offers a better avalanche rate and faster performance compared to conventional algorithms. In conclusion, this study provides a promising solution for addressing security concerns in OBS networks.

articleTitle: Dual Memory Search - Harmony Search Algorithm for Load Balancing in Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In Cloud Computing (CC) environment, load balancing among Virtual Machine (VMs) with various task lengths, start time, and execution time presents a significant challenge. Effective load balancing ensures that workloads are distributed dynamically across VMs, preventing any from being overloaded or underutilized, which otherwise can cause excessive energy consumption. In this research, the proposed Dual Memory Search - Harmony Search Algorithm (DMSHSA) efficiently searches multiple solutions in parallel, allowing for optimal distribution of workloads across VMs. The DMSHSA enhances load balancing by optimizing task allocation based on the execution requirements, helping to minimize the response time and energy consumption. The proposed load balancing algorithm is implemented using Python for evaluating its effectiveness in terms of energy consumption, latency, and throughput. The developed DMS-HSA achieves a makespan of $\mathbf{2. 5 5}, \mathbf{2. 7 8}, \mathbf{2. 9 9}, 3.23$ and 3.75, respectively, with $20,30,40,60$ and 80 VMs. The simulation outcomes show that the DMS-HSA based load balancing scheme outperforms the existing techniques namely, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) Enhanced Q-Learning algorithm (QMPSO) and Parallel PSO (PPSO) algorithm.

Author Keywords: parallel particle swarm optimization and virtual machine

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Logistics Distribution System Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In the context of global integration, the efficiency and cost-effectiveness of logistics and distribution systems are crucial to improving corporate competitiveness. In view of the problems such as high cost, low efficiency and slow response speed in urban logistics distribution, this paper uses the ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm to construct a road network optimization model for intelligent road planning. The research first analyzes the application status of ant colony algorithm in the field of logistics and distribution and the challenges it faces, and improves the search efficiency and adaptability of the algorithm through parameter optimization and heuristic strategy adjustment. Experimental results show that compared with genetic algorithm, simulated annealing algorithm and nearest neighbor algorithm, ant colony algorithm has significant advantages in average delivery time, vehicle utilization and average delivery cost. The research results of this article not only highlight the application potential of the ant colony algorithm in actual logistics distribution, but also provide a new technical approach for the optimization of logistics distribution systems.

articleTitle: Energy Storage System Capacity Optimization Configuration using Trigonometric Function based Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: An effective energy storage system in micro grid is optimized for enhancing the reasonable distribution of power and enhance the service life of the storage system. However, the existing optimization algorithms used for optimizing the energy storage system capacity face difficulties due to dynamic fluctuation and other intermittent characteristics of renewable resources. To overcome this problem, a Trigonometric function-based Particle Swarm Optimization (TRIG-PSO) algorithm for energy storage system capacity optimization configuration in micro grid. The velocity of the particle is modified using trigonometric functions, that controls the acceleration and deceleration of particles in PSO algorithm. This modulation reduces the extreme fluctuations in movement of particle, to provide stable convergence process. Initially, the power is generated from wind, photovoltaic and hydrogen resources, based on this an energy storage system is designed with the fuel cell and electrolytic cell. After that, the objective functions like cost and storage system lifetime are determined with constrains to optimize the energy storage system capacity. The experimental results show that proposed TRIG-PSO model achieved better results when compared to existing methods such as Modified PSO (MPSO).

articleTitle: A Hybrid CNN-RNN Model for Enhanced Pneumonia Detection using X-Ray Imaging
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This paper introduces a robust deep learning framework for the detection of pneumonia using chest X-ray images, emphasizing the integration of both spatial and temporal data for enhanced diagnostic accuracy. Initially, the research employed standard CNNs to assess their baseline efficacy in identifying pneumonia-related abnormalities within X-ray images. Building upon this, the investigation progressed to more sophisticated hybrid architectures, including CNN-RNNs, CNN-LSTMs, and CNN-GRUs. These hybrid models synergize the powerful spatial feature extraction capabilities of CNNs with the temporal sequence processing strengths of RNNs, LSTMs, and GRUs. Experimental results demonstrated that the CNN-LSTM model achieved the highest accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8 . 5 \%}$, significantly outperforming traditional CNNs, which achieved $93 \%$ accuracy. The findings underscore the potential of these hybrid deep learning models in providing reliable, real-time clinical decision support for pneumonia detection, offering notable improvements in diagnostic accuracy and recall over traditional models.

articleTitle: Cloud-based Task Scheduling in a Secure Data-Sharing Scheme using a Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Because of the dynamic nature of data dissemination in cloud computing, traditional database views in conventional architecture present several issues for data miners. This paper offers a methodology that applies the k-means approach to data mining in such cases. These days, one of the most essential issues is the need for new high-speed cloud services. Various load-balancing techniques, such as Secure Data Sharing Schemes (SDSS), Attribute-Based Encryption, and Byte-Cyclic Encryption (CP-ABE) algorithms, have already been considered effective ways to allocate requests in a cloud context. Cloud computing technology is introduced, and the mass information processing capacity reconfiguration of the distribution automation main station is proposed by leveraging its high dependability, dynamic resource adjustment, and other features. Non-preemptive task scheduling is irreversible; thus, it is started at the above virtual machine and allocated to the right ones. Various dependent activities that can finish self-governing tasks on different virtual machines and many cores on the same virtual machine are typically included in starting tasks.

Author Keywords: attribute-based encryption and byte cyclic encryption (CP-ABE) algorithm

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Character Animations based on Dove Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Recently, emotion generating approach of animation is not easily seen in the application of animation design and development due to the lack of image details. However, the process produces animated expressions that are not natural. To address this difficulty, a Deep Learning (DL) technique called Dove Swarm Optimization Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Network (DSOA-CNN) is utilized to extract facial expression feature images from real images. The research objective is to improve the character animation production quality and emotion detection by utilizing the application of DL technology. CNN is utilized to generate and extract features from motion data and frames, whereas DSOA rectifies movement patterns and key frame selections for more fluid animation. This hybrid approach creates realistic and fluid character animations, particularly in virtual scenarios, while increasing accuracy and efficiency by hybridizing CNN capabilities with DSOA algorithm. The results demonstrated that the with a PCC of 0.99, the suggested DSOA-CNN technique outperformed existing methodology such as Ensemble Median Empirical Mode Decomposition (MEEMD), Deep Neural Network (DNN), and CNN approach.

articleTitle: Ripeness Detection of Areca Nut Using AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Arecanut is a commercial crop widely cultivated in India, which ranks second in global arecanut production. Harvesting arecanuts at specific stages is crucial for optimal yield. Traditionally, two skilled workers are required: a professional tree climber to pluck the nuts and an examiner to check ripeness by peeling a few nuts with their teeth. This method is laborintensive, time-consuming, and potentially dangerous. In order to address these issues by using an AlexNet-based machine learning model to accurately predict nut ripeness, thus reducing losses. The system, comprising a webcam, Raspberry Pi, and cutter unit, captures images of arecanut bunches. Features like color, shape, size, and texture are analyzed to classify nuts as ripened, intermediate, or unripened. If the nuts are ripe, a buzzer alerts the user to cut the bunch using a remote-controlled cutter unit.

articleTitle: A Combined Support Vector Data DescriptionFuzzy Logic Approach for Anomaly Detection in Credit Card Transactions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Now a days, as the technology has revolutionized a number of online transactions which had grown up in large sizes and grabs a vast portion of these transactions. The speedy involvement of credit card transactions resulted in tremendous losses to the people’s wealth as increase in the fraudulent transactions. The traditional models which are assisted in detection of anomalies had less accuracy and failed in classifying complete anomalies. Therefore, this paper proposed a Support Vector Data Description (SVDD)-Fuzzy Logic for detection of anomalies in credit card transactions. The proposed method employed on credit card fraud detection dataset which holds transaction details of European Credit Card (ECC) holders. The transaction details obtained from dataset that has balanced by Synthetic Minority Oversampling Technique-Edited Nearest Neighbour (SMOTE-ENN) technique. These balanced data features are selected by Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) method which reduced the least significant features for selecting appropriate features. The obtained relevant features had classified into anomalies and positive datapoints by SVDD which employed Polynomial Self Learning Particle Swarm Optimization (PSLPSO) and Fuzzy Logic for improving model accuracy. The proposed SVDD-Fuzzy Logic achieved better accuracy ($98.50 \%$), Recall ($95.25 \%$), precision ($98.90 \%$) and F1 Score ($97.45 \%$) compared to existing Generative Adversial Network.

articleTitle: Bilinear Convolutional Neural Network with Random Projection Paradigm based Classification of Micro Plastics in Marine Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, the immense growth of micro plastic pollution in the marine environment increased the attentions globally. Micro plastics particles referred as the chemical substances and polymers based on different types of toxic substances the pollutes the marine water when it decomposed into monomers. Thus, in existing researches, machine learning algorithms utilized for classification, however, these methods have drawbacks of misclassification due to variation in appearance of the plastic compounds which are in micro size. To overcome this drawback, a Bilinear Convolutional Neural Network with Random Projection Paradigm (BCNN-RPP) method is proposed for precise classification of micro plastics in marine environment. The proposed BCNN-RPP model obtained the texture variations of the plastic compounds efficiently which are crucial is differentiating the various kinds of micro plastics. The RPP technique improve the ability of the proposed BCNN model to classify the complex plastic compounds accurately. The experimental results of the proposed BCNN-RPP achieved high accuracy than the existing classification approaches like Mask Region-Convolutional Neural Network (Mask-R-CNN).

articleTitle: An Efficient Cluster based Co-Operative-ED Max Selection Algorithm for Improving the Detection Accuracy of SU Nodes in CR — WSN
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Cognitive Radio-Wireless Sensor Networks (CR-WSNs) offer a solution to the spectrum limitations faced by traditional Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) by utilizing idle frequencies within licensed bands. By detecting and exploiting these spectrum holes, CR-WSNs can reduce interference and enhance network performance. However, energy conservation is a critical concern due to the limited battery capacity of sensor nodes. This research paper proposes a collaborative based sensing methodology using the Energy Detection (ED) technique, analyzed under different decision-making logics: AND, OR and the proposed Max Selection scheme. The Max Select scheme aims to significantly improve the detection accuracy while minimizing the probability of false alarms, compared to the conventional ED technique. By efficiently managing the energy resources and enhancing the sensing performance, the proposed scheme addresses key challenges in CR-WSNs, balancing the need for reliable spectrum detection with the constraints of energy consumption in these networks.

articleTitle: Explainable AI Framework for Enhanced Brain Tumour Detection and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: A brain tumour is rapid growth of cells in the brain. It needs accurate and early detection for effective treatment. This work introduces a novel approach to enhance interpretability of tumour. Using a publicly available dataset, this work focused on a baseline system using texture features and classified by Support Vector Machine (SVM) which resulted in an accuracy around $\mathbf{6 0 \%}$. Further, Deep Learning (DL) using finetuned Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture is employed to improve system performance. This model achieves an accuracy of $\mathbf{9 8. 9 5 \%}$, sensitivity of $\mathbf{9 6. 8 1 \%}$, and specificity of $\mathbf{9 9. 6 5 \%}$. Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) techniques like Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) are also employed to improve the explainability of the detected tumour for enhancing the decision-making by radiologists.

articleTitle: A Few-Shot Complex Chip Defect Detection Algorithm Guided by Priori Boxes
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: chip surfaces are characterized by complex textures, and defect samples are limited in variety, making it difficult to ensure the accuracy of defect detection. to address this issue, this paper proposes a defect detection algorithm guided by prior boxes. first, different weights are assigned based on the detection priority of different chip regions and the consistency of positive samples, guiding the feature extraction network to selectively extract positive sample features. then, a small number of real defect samples are used to fine-tune the object segmentation model, and a fusion detection model is constructed based on the prediction probability box of the object segmentation network and the similarity between the test sample and the positive sample features. finally, experiments are conducted on a real dataset collected from a chip production line. the experimental results demonstrate that, in terms of few-shot complex chip surface defect detection, this method improves accuracy compared to traditional defect detection algorithms.

articleTitle: Automatic Chinese Composition Evaluation System Based on Distilled Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, the Chinese compositions become critical and complex to evaluate since it consume more time and also required automated solutions to enhance the efficacy of the evaluation system. Previous researchers have suggested many ML models but still the system face challenges such as tonal variations, diverse vocabulary, and nuanced sentence structures which makes it difficult to build an effective system. Hence, this paper develops a robust evaluation system by incorporating numerous advanced Machine Learning (ML) models which are verified through the Sogou News cohort. Firstly, the Sogou News dataset is employed, and then the data is pre-processed to clean the data using various techniques that include tokenization, lowercasing, punctuation removal, and normalization. Further, from the processes data optimal features are extracted by imposing Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TFIDF) and Word2Vec to improve text classification. In the end Distilled Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (Distil-BERT) is employed to generate text embedding for effective evaluation of chinese composition. The suggested Distil-BERT model provides higher accuracy in the Chinese composition with higher accuracy value when compared existing models SGCSTC, RoBERT+HRL. As a result, the accuracy of $98.89 \%$, F 1 score is $98.88 \%$, precision is 98.64%, recall is 97.67%.

Author Keywords: distilled bidirectional encoder representations from transformers

articleTitle: Enhanced Fast Recovery Dynamic Assembly Period Algorithm for TCP over OBS Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Assembly algorithm plays a vital role in the functionality of OBS networks. In this article, the fixed and dynamic assembly period algorithms are analyzed and also, we proposed Enhanced Fast Recovery dynamic assembly period Algorithm (EFRDAP) to decrease the burst loss probability. In contrast, the proposed algorithm is simulated and contrasted with the fixed and dynamic assembly period algorithms. From the results it is evident that the proposed EFRDAP algorithm gives better performance in the aspect of reduction in burst dropping rate and increase in throughput.

Author Keywords: enhanced fast recovery dynamic assembly algorithm(EFRDAP)

articleTitle: Academic Warning for College Students for Predicting Student Dropout Rate using Dipper Throated Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: From past few years, educational institutions record student details for monitoring and analysing individual student performance based on their courses. The academic warning for college students who are logged into the system, the details accessed at the time of learning stage and number of times the particular student logged in particular course. Predicting student dropout rate face an issue in class imbalance such as majority of students remained with the enrolled and huge dropouts. Additionally, the presence of missing data in student’s records gives difficulty in predicting dropout rate. To overcome these challenges, Dipper Throated Optimization (DTO) is proposed for predicting optimal features from Massive Open Online Courses (MOOC) dataset. The student’s data are taken from the MOOC dataset which undergoes pre-processing by using Z-score normalization technique to reduce feature dominance. Then, the normalized features are further processed into feature selection with DTO method to select optimal features. After that, the selected features are further processed with Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier to classify student dropout rate as dropout or persist. The proposed DTO method gives better results than existing Logistic Regression (LR) model in terms of accuracy (0.95), precision (0.96), recall (0.98) and $F1$ score (0.97) respectively.

articleTitle: Fused Feature Vector based DenseNet201 with Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network for Forest Fire Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The rise in temperature on the earth is one of the main sources for the cause of fire in the forest area. The dry vegetation of the forest leads to sudden fire in the forest. Various technologies have been introduced to capture the aerial views of the forest to monitor the ongoing actions. The different existing methods failed to predict the occurrence of the fire in the forest area due to lack of feature dimensionalities handling and noises generated during the training process that reduced the performance of appropriate forest fire prediction. To overcome the existing problems the Fused Feature Vector Based DenseNet201 (FFV-DenseNet201) is proposed with the Deep Convolutional Generative Adversarial Network (DCGAN). The min-max normalization was used in the pre-processing stage to rescale the image pixel ranges. The FFV-DenseNet201 is used to extract the significant features from the images. The DCGAN algorithm was used to predict the fire and non-fire forest images. The developed FFV-DenseNet 201 and DCGAN has obtained better results of $\mathbf{9 8. 3 4 \%}$ accuracy, $\mathbf{9 9. 0 1 \%}$ of precision, $\mathbf{9 8. 2 9 \%}$ recall and $\mathbf{9 8. 6 4 \%}$ f1-score respectively for the FLAME dataset compared to existing YOLOv5 model.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Operation Status and Analysis of Transformation Effectiveness of Medium Voltage Distribution Network based on Ensemble model
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In present scenario, evaluating transformation effectiveness in medium voltage distribution networks involves assessing the impact of upgrades, repairs, or reconfigurations on network performance, and efficiency by ensuring with optimal power supply and minimizing losses, faults, and downtime. It faces difficulties in measure the true impact of network upgrades or changes. To overcome those drawbacks this paper, proposed Convolutional Neural Network- Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-LSTM) technique efficiently analysis the verification of collecting input data, initially utilized a power grid dataset, which undergoes data preprocessing through three key steps such as cleaning, grouping, and interpolation. Then, feature extraction is performed using time-frequency analysis. The proposed classification model is a hybrid CNN-LSTM approach, leveraging the assets of both CNN and LSTM. This integrated model is trained and tested on the pre-processed data, demonstrating its effectiveness in classifying operation status and transformation effectiveness enables robust extraction of spatial features from images and temporal modeling of sequential and for forecasting of complex phenomena. The performance of proposed model evaluated the various metrics such as precision (0.995%), recall ($\mathbf{0. 9 8 9 \%)}$) and F1 score ($\mathbf{0. 9 9 6 \%}$) metrics on power grid dataset.

articleTitle: Wavelet Transform based Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory for Predicting Water Demand
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)

authors.preferredName: R Rana Veer Samara Sihman Bharattej

abstract: The prediction of urban water demand is essential in rational allocation of water and developing smart city. Influenced through multiple factors, the water demand huge frequency noise and difficult patterns, that is due to nostationary of daily data has huge influence on generalization capability of methods. In this research, Wavelet Transform (WT) and Hodrick-Prescott (HP) techniques are utilized to decompose of daily data for resolving an issue of non-stationary. Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (BiLSTM), Seasonal Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) and Gaussian Radial Basis Function Neural Network (GRBFNN) are introduced to predicting various subseries. Ensemble learning is implemented for enhancing a generalization capability of methods and interval prediction is produced depended on t-test of students is handled along difference of laws in water supply. The coupling and WT techniques correctly predicted the water demand and give optimum 0.19% of Mean Square Error (MSE), 3.37% of Mean Absolute Error (MAE), 0.2 of Mean Relative Error (MRE), 97.25% of Nash-Sutcliffe Efficiency (NSE) and 0.99 of Correlation coefficient.

Author Keywords: gaussian radial basis function neural network
seasonal auto regressive integrated moving average and wavelet transform

articleTitle: Prediction of Time Series Data based on PCA-HMM-BN
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This present work describes a framework for the analysis of score dynamics and energy fluctuations in competitive environments, aimed at forecasting match outcomes and providing strategic decisions useful to coaching and players’ performance. Potential energy was defined, seven key measures were identified related to Kendall’s tau, shown as heat maps to outline the underlying patterns. Using the CV method and the AHP composite weighting, overall scores can determine the overall possible energy level of players. The line graph should be drawn based on the latter in order to assess volatility throughout the course of the match. Then, it carries out a derivation method for potential energy series, followed by extracting the most critical turning points in energy dynamics through the PCA-HMM-BN algorithm. Feature engineering with lag features and effect coding improves predictability. This graph presents a comparison among different machine learning models, namely BP Neural Network, XGBoost, and SVM, by showing the high performance obtained by an SVM model tuned with the ASAA algorithm, with an R-squared score of 0.99967.

articleTitle: Copy-Move Image Forgery Detection using Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The advancement of digital image processing software has reached a stage where it is effortless to manufacture forgeries by using numerous manipulating approaches on authentic photos. Occupations such as law, healthcare, and education are susceptible to manipulated imagery. Therefore, it is crucial to ascertain the authenticity of an image. Single type of image manipulation is identified as ‘copy move,’ when significant item or objects are concealed by duplicating and inserting them into the original image. It is crucial to determine whether an image is genuine. The current techniques employed to identify image forgeries relied on conventional feature extraction algorithms, such as key point and block-based algorithms. These conventional approaches yield a subpar outcome. Deep learning approaches have established superior performance in image processing applications. This paper presents a highly effective method for identifying instances of copy-move forgery in images using a hybrid approach that combines deep learning (DL) such as (VGG19 and ResNet50) for feature extraction and Machine Learning (ML) algorithms including (Random Forests (RF) and Support Vector Machine (SVM)) to classify digital images. The proposed models (VGG19-RF), (VGG19-SVM), (ResNet50-RF), and (ResNet50-SVM) have been compared using two standard datasets. The results indicate that ((VGG19-RF) achieves higher recall, accuracy, precision and F1-score of 97% on MICC-F220 dataset, On the other hand (VGG19-RF) and (ResNet50-RF) achieve higher recall, precision, accuracy and F1-score of 97% on the MICC-F2000 dataset.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Repair Effect of Deep Learning Algorithms on Abnormal Images
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Given the common reasons for abnormal phenomena in images and the harm caused by abnormal images, this paper proposes an unsupervised feature learning algorithm for pixel prediction based on image content structure to address the issue of image missing. The designed image content structure encoder based on convolutional neural networks not only understands the content of the entire image, but also generates a reasonable assumption for the missing parts. During feature learning, it not only captures the appearance, but also captures the semantics of the visual structure. Therefore, the content of any image region can be generated reasonably. When training the image content structure encoder, $\mathbf{L} 2$ construction loss and adversarial loss are used. And it was validated on the experimental dataset in the deep learning Caffe framework. Experimental results have shown that the network model designed in this article can improve the quality of image restoration and achieve high efficiency.

articleTitle: Fine Operation and Maintenance Technology of Intelligent Park Equipment Based on Virtual Reality Immersion Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Aiming at the problematic background of low efficiency and complex management of equipment operation and maintenance in intelligent parks, this paper proposes a refined operation and maintenance solution based on virtual reality immersive technology. Firstly, the equipment demand of the intelligent park is analyzed in detail through the questionnaire survey, and the key demand in operation and maintenance management is identified; then, the construction plan of intelligent park operation and maintenance management system using the combination of virtual reality immersive technology and Internet of Things technology is proposed, and the detailed design of the system architecture and key technologies is carried out; finally, the front-end interface of the system is constructed by utilizing the immersive characteristics of the virtual reality technology. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional operation and maintenance methods, the method proposed in this paper significantly reduces the equipment failure rate, the average failure rate is reduced by 5.44%, and at the same time improves the user satisfaction, showing the effectiveness and advantages of the operation and maintenance system in reducing equipment failure and improving user experience.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Distributed Denial of Service Attack Detection using Deep Learning Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks are among the most dangerous threats in cyberspace impacting areas such as the Internet of Things (IoT), Cybersecurity, and Cloud Computing, which leads to network interruptions. DDoS attacks target IoT environments by manipulating IoT networks, consuming resources and interrupting services, leading to privacy challenges and performance degradation. However, accurate detection of DDoS attacks is difficult, due to their various DDoS attack types, heterogeneity of network security and complexity of communication protocols. Advanced Deep Learning (DL) approaches have been employed for effective detection of DDoS attacks while reducing false-positive rates and improving high detection rates of the different network traffic patterns. The DL algorithms such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Bidirectional Long-Short Term Memory (Bi-LSTM), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN), and Deep Neural Networks (DNN) are used for the detection of DDoS attacks. This survey focuses on analyzing the advantages and limitations of different DL algorithms used for DDoS attack detection. The performance of the DL models is evaluated based on performance metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.

Author Keywords: distributed denial of service attack detection

articleTitle: Optimization and Prediction Algorithm of Network Security Situation Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In response to the time variability and nonlinearity issues in predicting the current network security situation, this article introduces big data analysis technology and combines it with the Cloud Computing Online Extreme Learning Machine (CC-OELM) model to optimize the prediction algorithm of network security situation, improve the accuracy and stability of prediction. Firstly, this article analyzes existing network security prediction models and identifies the limitations of traditional methods in the big data environment. Then, the CC-OELM model is designed and optimized, dividing the network security situation data into multiple sub training sets. Finally, experiments conducted on large-scale samples have shown that the optimized model has significant advantages in dealing with nonlinear and dynamically changing network security issues. Through comparative experiments on multiple models, when the number of samples is 4000, the expansion rate is 0.271. This model can maintain good scalability in large-scale data processing, providing theoretical support and practical basis for active defense of network security.

articleTitle: Implementing Support Vector Machine Method for Predicting Urban Area Water Quality
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Water quality failure is a long-standing global issue, causing illness, poisoning, spread of diseases, and claiming human lives in urban areas. Urban growth patterns have a substantial impact on stream water quality because they affect pollutant formation, buildup, and wash-off process. To successfully advise urban growth planning and policies, stream water quality must be evaluated and predicted in relation to various urban development patterns. In this work, Support Vector Machine (SVM) is implemented to predict quality of water in urban areas. Initially, data are collected through collected dataset, and the cleaning and normalization techniques are utilized to remove missing values and outliers and normalized the data. Then, SVM method is employed to effectively predict the quality of water. When compared to existing methods like genetic algorithm_extreme gradient boosting (GA_XGBoost), and artificial neural networks (ANNs), implemented SVM achieved high values of 0.953 of $R 2,0.03$ of Root-mean-square error (RMSE), 0.01 of Mean Absolute Error (MAE), 9 of average invalidity percent (AIP), and 99 of average validity percent (AVP) performance result.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled Smart Vehicle with CNN and Deep Face for Anti-Theft Detection System
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This paper addresses the urgent need for vehicle safety and security amidst the escalating occurrences of road accidents and thefts. It delves into the shortcomings of existing security systems and their ramifications on public safety and property loss. It investigates the fusion of IoT devices and neural networks to reinforce vehicle security measures. It provides a comprehensive analysis of how face detection in real time was achieved using the Haar-Cascade Algorithm and face matching was through the DeepFace technique. Additionally, the implementation includes real-time alerts via email utilizing the Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP), with attachments showcasing unauthorized individuals. Notably, the integration of CNN enables real-time threat detection, thereby mitigating the risks associated with road accidents and thefts. The accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores of CNN applied for DeepFace are mentioned in result section also compared with existing work. This paper concludes by highlighting its findings, emphasizing the efficacy of IoT-based vehicle security systems employing neural networks, which boost both cost and energy efficiency owing to their reduced sensor count.

articleTitle: Power Efficient and Timing Closure for Different Encoders for 3 bit Flash ADC using TIQ Comparator
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In this paper, a 3-bit Flash Analog to Digital Converter (ADC) is designed with TIQ comparators. The proposed design requires 7 comparators, an encoder to convert thermometer code to binary code. The analyses 3 different encoders such as Wallace Tree, Rom Based and Mux Based for the implementation of 3 bit Flash ADC. The proposed design is implemented using Tanner tool with TSpice. The performance analysis with respect to power consumption, area is studied. The result shows Mux Based 3 bit Flash ADC provides better performance compared to Flash ADC Designed using Wallace Tree or Rom based encoder.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Athlete’s Competitive Ability based on XLNet Transformer and Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent days, sports are organized as a physical activities which include games, competition, and skills which enhance fitness, entertainment, and motivate for success. It also motivates aspects like discipline, and teamwork. Additionally, evaluation of athlete’s competitive ability is complex because of multifaceted skills such as mental resilience. Moreover, standardized assessments are not collecting sport specific types which lead to incomplete evaluation. It is also difficult replicate the performance because it might be influenced because of stress and competition. To overcome these issues paper proposed a model for Evaluation of Athletes’ Competitive Ability XLNet with Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) for evaluation, effectively achieving better accuracy. Initially, the questionnaire is generated by using Technology Acceptance Model (TAM 3) then further filtration and evaluation is performed through Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and Structural Equation Model (SEM). Then, after the evaluation the optimal attributes are trained using XLNet transformer. Later the trained attributes are classified using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KAN) then finally the evaluation is performed using confusion metrics. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated using metrics like accuracy, precision, and recall respectively.

articleTitle: BER Performance Analysis of OFDM for 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: With the goals of boosting system capacity, achieving low latency, enhancing user throughput, and supporting “Internet of things” services, fifth generation(5G) mobile systems have been implemented globally. The standards group for Third- Generation-Partnership-Project (3GPP) has authorized Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) for 5G mobile technologies which is a well-known method that exhibits resilience against frequency-selective fading channels. There are numerous wired and wireless communication systems that make extensive use of this technology. Fast Fourier transform (FFT) and inverse Fourier transform (IFFT) operations are utilized in OFDM systems for modulation and demodulation, with the varying magnitude of these operations depending on the application. Specific to 5G, an 1024-point FFT and FFT configured OFDM has been modelled using MATLAB Simulink and its functionally verified for BER parameter for BPSK, QPSK and QAM. A Quantitative analysis has been carried out for BPSK, QPSK and QAM with 0.4, 0.7 and 0.9.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Herbal Plant Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
