abstract: In herbal plant sciences, Deep Neural Network (DNN) integration has emerged as a potential new avenue that promises unparalleled achievements in the identification, classification, and understanding of the health benefits of herbal plants. This study explores the automation of image analysis and natural language processing (NLP) for the goal of herbal plant identification using DNNs, namely Hierarchical Feature Extraction Networks (HFEN) and Contextual Correlation Integration Networks (CCIN). By combining image processing and natural language processing (NLP) methods, this study offers a novel approach to plant classification. This suggests the use of a hierarchical feature extraction network to discriminate between distinct plant species based on visual signals, particularly leaf form. The network uses leaf picture data to extract multi-scale features such as texture, shape, vein pattern and colour to produce an accurate representation of each species. To increase classification accuracy, it also makes use of a contextual correlation integration network, which analyses textual data such as botanical descriptions using natural language processing (NLP). Through the alignment of visual features with contextual data, the dual-modality technique guarantees a classification system that is both more accurate and precise. The work offers a comprehensive analysis of the efficacy of numerous deep learning models.

articleTitle: Implementation of Probabilistic Operational Scenario Forecasting for Risk Analysis of Power Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Operational scenario generation and forecasting is considered vital for improving the performance of power distribution networks which is considered a non-trivial task. Currently, data-driven solutions have received increasing attention to address this challenge. The proactive fault risk assessment (PFRA) of power distribution networks is critical for power outage warnings and predictive maintenance. However, the available methods for modeling the uncertainties of the operation state are computed in statistical mean-variance from the predictor’s probability density function, which lacks intended risk information on uncertainties. This paper presents and implements a probabilistic operational scenario forecasting (POSF) solution for risk analysis of power distribution systems. The proposed solution is assessed through extensive simulation experiments and the numerical results demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed solution.

articleTitle: Lasso Regression with Radial Basis Function based Intelligent Music Teaching System
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, information of music education system helps to promote the music teaching by considering music disciplines including nature of music. The music evaluation systems which in exist with Radial Basis Function (RBF) based systems are inefficient solutions for the present difficulties such as lack of teachers and single teaching to realize the teaching resources. In this paper, a generalization technique LASSO regression with Radial Basis Function (Lasso-RBF) is proposed to enhance the performance of intelligent music teaching system. Primarily, the input data is taken from the lakh MIDI dataset and further processed for preprocessing with min-max normalization. Then, hamming window is introduced to extract the features including rhythms, pitches, and melody features. After that, Lasso regression is utilized to select the features to increase the model performance. Finally, the RBF technique is used for predicting the student’s outcomes for teaching music effectively. From the results, proposed LASSO-RBF method attained improved results when compared with existing model such as Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (GBDT) by providing results including accuracy (89.47%), AUG (95.50%), Recall (80.26%), and F1 score (85.92%) correspondingly.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Reducing Voltage Variation and Active Power Degeneracy in Optimum IPR Problem using Elitist NSGA-II and GWO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Enhancement heuristics likely NSGA-II and Grey Wolf Optimisation Algorithm presented in this study as a way to reduce voltage variation and active power degeneracy. Active power degeneracy and bus voltage discrepancies need reduction among the optimum IPR problem, which is a nonlinear constrained multi-faceted refinement concern. Since the issue is handled as a real multi-faceted refinement concern, several trade-off remedies are given. The selection of trade-off remedies from variants is executed by Pareto-optimal front which finalizes the choices undertaken. The validation of efficient performance by NSGA-II is well showcased utilizing the industry-standard IEEE 14-bus test system and IEEE 30 bus system. In IEEE 14 and 30 bus system SVC connected with the bus the real power loss and voltage Deviation output is reduced compared to without SVC buses. A comparative scenario among PSAT, NSGA-II and Grey Wolf Optimisation (GWO) has been well established projecting NSGA-II is suited for only multi-objective functions. Although GWO is intended for single-objective functions, multi-objective function situations can be modified to use it. It is a quick method of convergence.GWO method as dynamically efficient among others.

articleTitle: Forward Kinematics Algorithm for 6-DOF Parallel Platforms Combining Neural Networks and Iterative Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The field of automated assembly faces the challenge of precise component alignment. This study focuses on the assembly scenario where one component moves along the vertical axis for assembly, while the other component is positioned on a six-degree-of-freedom (6-DOF) parallel platform for adaptive pose adjustment. This paper proposes a new algorithm that combines neural networks with iterative computation to solve the forward kinematics of the parallel platform, achieving precise coordination with the Z-axis. Experiments have shown that the algorithm effectively plans the platform’s motion trajectory, with position accuracy reaching below 0.005 mm and pose error controlled within 0.003 radians. The new algorithm excels in improving assembly precision and is suitable for pre-planned motion trajectory scenarios, providing effective technical support for the field of automated assembly.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of Scientific Research Platform Management based Improved Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Recently, numerous factors are required with the differentiated and innovative technique-based scientific research management. However, the innovative model is required to solve the typical software development with high effort and restricted capacity to adjust to changing needs. Hence, to evaluate the efficacy of scientific research platform, the Improved Back Propagation Neural Network (IBPNN) is developed and non-linear correlations were examined. Initially, innovation method based on platform modeling is used to systematically identify prospective consumers for engagement in platform evolution. Through strategic learning and monitoring, the client acquires data related to strategic improvement preparation and management judgements. An attractive core platform offer and an abundance of auxiliary services are made available by platform adoption. Control measures then enable the appropriate procedural incorporation of another services and applications into the platform model. In order facilitate accurate decision-making, this research recommended that weights be optimized by providing accurate predictions. According to the results, it illustrates that with a 98.45% efficiency and a 20.25% energy consumption decrease, the suggested IBPNN system outperformed the existing models such as Ecological Institutional Norms (EIN), Original Web Platform (OWP), and Dynamic Performance Management (DPM).

articleTitle: Automatic Road Extraction using Scale Invariant Feature Transform-based Random Forest in Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Road Extraction from High-Resolution Satellite Images (HRSI) plays a significant role in the analysis of the remote sensor image field. The extraction of road automatically labels a road’s pixels in a satellite image with semantic features depending on topographical meaningful features. However, manual road extraction inaccurately extracts road networks from satellite images which has significant difficulties like complex urban environments, varying road types, and diverse image conditions. Therefore, the Scale Invariant Feature Transform-based Random Forest(SIFT-RF) is proposed for automatic road extraction in satellite images. First, the image is obtained from DeepGlobe dataset and Z-score normalization is employed to maximize model performance. Then, SIFT is established to extract the road network in satellite images. Finally, the RF is utilized to extract and classify roads as road or non-road using Machine Learning (ML). The SIFT-RF achieves a greater f1-score of 98.24% compared to existing methods like Dual-Attention Road extraction Network (DA-RoadNet), High-Resolution U-Net architecture (HRU-Net), and Global Context-aware and Batch-independent Network (GCBNet) respectively.

Author Keywords: scale invariant feature transform and z-score normalization

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition System with Hybrid CNN and Random Forest Models for Autonomous Driving Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Accurate traffic sign recognition is crucial for driver assistance systems, yet challenges persist due to environmental factors and camera distortions. This study introduces a novel framework for real-time traffic sign detection and classification using vehicle dash-cams. The system employs a fine-tuned YOLOv8 model for detection, achieving mAP50 of 99.348%. Classification utilizes a two-stage approach: VGG16-based image embedding generation followed by Random Forest classification, resulting in an F 1 score of 98.61%. The model is trained on a diverse dataset combining GTSRB and web-scraped images, with extensive augmentation to enhance robustness. Additionally, Microsoft’s TrOCR extracts numerical values from speed limit signs. This hybrid approach merges the strengths of convolutional neural networks and Random Forests, producing a robust solution even with a very limited amount of training data. The system’s high accuracy and real-time performance significantly enhance driver safety by ensuring reliable traffic sign recognition across various conditions.

articleTitle: Optimization Analysis of Wireless Sensor Coverage Indoor Positioning Based on KWAP-KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In complex indoor environments, due to factors such as multipath effects, attenuation, and occlusion of signals, indoor positioning results often have significant errors. This study proposes for the first time to optimize the traditional KNN algorithm by introducing the KWAP-KNN (Kernel Weighted Average Precision k-Nearest Neighbors) algorithm, aiming to reduce indoor positioning errors caused by factors such as signal attenuation and multipath effects. Firstly, by introducing the kernel weight method, the nearest neighbor selection in traditional KNN is improved. Then, using the improved weight allocation mechanism, combined with nearest neighbor prediction, the accuracy and stability of localization are improved. Finally, through actual indoor positioning experiments, the effectiveness of KWAP-KNN algorithm in improving environmental adaptability and reducing the influence of outliers and noise data is verified. The experimental results show that the positioning accuracy of KWAP-KNN algorithm is superior to traditional KNN and weighted KNN algorithms in obstacle free, dynamic obstacle free, and highdensity obstacle environments, with an average error of only 0.5 meters in high-density obstacle environments. The research results further validate the application value of KWAP-KNN algorithm in the field of indoor positioning, and provide technical support for optimizing real-time positioning systems, demonstrating its broad application prospects in future smart devices and IoT technology.

articleTitle: Construction of Dynamic Correlation Model between Stock and Gold Markets Based on DCC-MVGARCH
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Investments play a crucial role in the stock and gold markets. The link between the two markets is particularly important for investors, especially those aiming to manage risk factors and design portfolio strategies related to the bond, equity and gold markets. Understanding the dynamics between these two markets will help optimize investment decisions. In this study, a DCC-MVGARCH model is used to determine the correlation and volatility changes between the equity and gold markets. The DCC-MVGARCH methodology will be used to uniquely model the dynamics of the correlation between the equity and gold markets. Through this model, we will calculate the correlation coefficient between stock market and gold market and analyze and discuss it using monthly data. The results of the study show that the correlation coefficient between the stock market and the gold market exhibits high correlation in most of the months, showing a positive linear relationship between the two. This finding is in line with previous findings revealing high correlation between stock market and gold market. This may be due to the influence of shared economic factors or investor behavior.

articleTitle: Fraud Detection in Accounting and Finance Enhanced by Knowledge-Driven GAT Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Accounting fraud detection (FAFD) has recently emerged as a popular topic in academic circles, industry, and government agencies as a direct result of the correlation between the present economic situation and an increase in financial accounting fraud. Forensic accountants bring their specialized knowledge to the table to help unearth financial accounting crimes when internal auditing systems fail to detect red flags. This method entails three stages: feature selection, model training, and preprocessing. Business organizations’ financial statements, whether fraudulent or not, as well as letters to shareholders and financial news, are pre-processed using the CKIP system. In this proposed approach to use the simplest statistical technique during the features selection phase. Throughout training, it made use of a knowledge GAT. This innovative method outperforms Knowledge Graph and Attention Network, with an average accuracy of 95.43%.

articleTitle: Recommendation System for Teaching Vocal Music for College students based on Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory with Capsule Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In today’s generation, people are interested to learn and explore numerous types of skills to enjoy their life such as music, dance, art, photography etc. From the research, it is analyzed most of the college students are interested and passionate about the vocal music however evaluating vocal music performance is a challenging task due to the complex and subjective nature of music which requires several parameters to compute such as pitch, tone quality, rhythm, presentation and modulation. Many previous researchers have suggested various conventional methods but still could not resolve and accurately recommend better system to evaluate the vocal music. So, to develop a better recommendation system, this paper suggests an effective approach namely Bi-LSTM-CapsNet for development of College vocal music teaching system using Fuzzy evaluation and Bi-directional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) with Capsule Networks (CapsNet). Here, fuzzy evaluation is employed to model fuzzy logic and rules that assist to handle and model the ambiguities in-built in musical assessment. To further fine-tune this process, a recommendation system is suggested where Bi-LSTM detects sequential patterns of the college students then, CapsNet recognizes temporal and spatial features, enhancing the model’s ability to interpret complex aspects of vocal quality. So by combing these algorithms enhances the ability to evaluate the vocal music among college students.

articleTitle: Construction of Sponge City Optimization Design Model Based on High-Dimensional Multi-Objective Evolutionary Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Building the concept of sponge cities to address flood and water management challenges in urban development and improve the ecological environment. The design and construction of sponge cities is a multi-objective complex optimization problem that involves significant trade-offs since multiple factors need to be accounted for. In this study, we construct a sponge city optimal design model for multi-objective optimization based on NSGA-II algorithm considering rainwater utilization, flood risk and ecological environment as the key indicators. The framework finds a set of non-inferior solutions through NSGA-II algorithm that trades off among these competing objectives. The different solutions provided by the framework can be selected based on one’s needs and context, but the method of this study presents a very significant step forward from a decision-making perspective. This study demonstrates once more how this algorithm has a good potential related to searching for optimal decision solutions in multi-objective optimization.

Author Keywords: high level multi-objective evolutionary optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Application of English Corpus using Long-Short Term Memory with Multiplicative Attention Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: English corpus is primarily utilized in Natural Language Processing (NLP) by generating an extensive linguistic information for training model. English corpora increase language teaching tools in linguistics by providing insights into grammar, vocabulary, and sematic patterns. However, the English Corpus lies in its huge linguistic diversity and context dependencies that leads to difficulties in accurately determining nuanced meanings. This process affects the performance of NLP specifically managing idiomatic ambiguities, expressions, and evolving language usage. In this research, the Long-Short Term Memory with Multiplicative Attention Algorithm (LSTM-MAA) is proposed for English corpus. In traditional LSTM, the MAA is incorporated to increase the model’s ability to focus on appropriate parts of the input sequence which enhance context representation. The LSTM-MAA enable the model to dynamically adjust its focus that leads to better performance. Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient(MFCC) is used to extract the features while conserving significant phonetic data which enhance the performance of English corpora. The proposedLSTM-MAA achieves a better accuracy of 99.87% compared to the existing methods like Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN).

Author Keywords: long-short term memory with multiplicative attention algorithm

articleTitle: Research on Anti Interference Technology of Beidou Receiver based on LBFGS Quasi-Newton Method
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In China, BeiDou navigation satellite system is a Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) which was developed by China only. The BeiDou receiver uses a pseudo range transmission for anti interference technology. However, the conventional anti interference technique leads to the deviation of GNSS receiver ranging score which was complex to the enhancement of higher precision ranging receiver. Therefore, this research proposes a Limit-Broyden-Fletcher-Goldfarb-Shanno Quasi-Newton (LBFGS-QN) method for anti interference technology of BeiDou receiver. The LBFGS-QN improves the BeiDou receiver performance through optimization of efficient filtering interference functions which improving its navigation and communications. The LBFGS-QN improves the reception capacity for adjustment of signal processing parameter sets according to the interference pattern, guaranteeing signal stability at lesser Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR). The LBFGS-QN method performance is calculated by the following metrics such as SNR, Bit Error Rate (BER), Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE). The LBFGS-QN achieves SNR of 16.0, BER of 0.0059, MSE of 0.010 and RMSE of 0.055 for the signal amplitude of 250 dB which is better than state-of-art algorithms.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization and Improved Beetle Antenna Search-based Sparrow Search Algorithm for Optimal Planning Distributed Photo Voltaic Access
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, Integration of Photovoltaic (PV) cells with distributed networks play a crucial role due to their capability to enhance the sustainability of renewable natural energy resources. Even though there is advantage still this system generates significant challenges for grid planning such as incorporating multiple distributed energy resources, and ensuring scalability for larger networks and thus it is essential to develop a grid planning system using hybrid optimization techniques. However, the intermittency and variability of PV generation pose significant challenges for grid planning, requiring advanced optimization techniques to ensure stability and efficiency. This paper suggest a novel hybrid approach using combination of optimization techniques such as Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Improved Beetle Antenna Search-Based Sparrow Search Algorithm (IBASSA) for grid planning with distributed photovoltaic access which is validated through bus (33) of IEEE Radial Distribution System (RDS). Here, PSO is incorporated because of its capability of fast convergence and IBASSA is imposed due to its characteristic behavior enhance global search function and avoid local optima. The proposed hybrid approach is evaluated using the metrics power loss and min voltage values that gave spectacular results when compared with existing models such as genetic algorithm.

Author Keywords: improved beetle antenna search-based sparrow search algorithm

articleTitle: Utilizing VCG Auction Method for Quality Assurance and Efficient Task Allocation in Uniform Crowdsourcing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Effective task allocation and quality control are pivotal in crowdsourcing environments, especially when dealing with homogeneous workers. This paper addresses these challenges by integrating the Vickrey-Clarke-Groves (VCG) auction mechanism with advanced computational optimization techniques. We propose a framework that leverages the VCG auction method to ensure truthful bidding and optimal task distribution among workers.Our approach simultaneously addresses task allocation and quality control by dynamically adjusting assignments based on real-time feedback and quality metrics. We also explore the impact of crowd dynamics on task performance and optimization, ensuring that our model adapts to varying crowd behaviors and maintains high-quality outcomes. This work provides a robust solution for optimizing task allocation and quality control in crowdsourcing platforms, offering significant improvements in both efficiency and reliability.

articleTitle: Travolution: Enhancing Road Safety and Promoting Responsible Driving Through Intelligent Embedded Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Travolution is an integrated, innovative technology aimed at ensuring safe road use through responsible driving. It possesses well-effective responses to curb some major causes of accidents, that is, infractions by traffic signals and drunken driving with its advanced features on safe driving. For example, vehicle speed control within variable zones can precisely determine the speed according to the different zones like highways, school zones, or residential areas so the driver will be well within the speed limit. Travolution implies the moving vehicles with information on toll gates and bumps so that they have a smooth ride and in case of accidents, it alerts the emergency ambulance services nearby with their required details for prompt action. It further identifies all probable risky behaviors including dangerous tilting of bikes, and gets all those real-time alerts to the Road Transport Office (RTO). Other features, which include horn control within noise-restricted zones, will reduce the problem of noise pollution, allowing safe and more disciplined driving.

articleTitle: Empowering the Disabled with Brain-Computer Interface
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This work presents a Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) system designed to help persons suffering from severe motor function loss due to accidents or diseases. The system enables users to control and interact with their external environment through neural signals. An Ag/AgCl electrode cap is placed on the scalp to capture the brain’s electrical activity, while an RMS 32-channel Electroencephalogram (EEG) data acquisition system amplifies the signals. The recorded signals from multiple subjects are converted into Excel format using suitable software. These data files are then processed in MATLAB using a similarity matching algorithm to detect patterns in event-related potentials. Based on the processed brain signals, the system performs specific actions, such as switching a fan or light bulb on or off through relays. Control of these external devices is achieved using an Arduino microcontroller. The system shows promising accuracy of 95% in translating brain activity into actionable commands and controlling external devices, offering potential for improved independence and quality of life for affected individuals. The proposed BCI system offers a potential communication pathway for persons with limited mobility, assisting them to interact with their surroundings more effectively.

articleTitle: Application Mathematics Universal Method Based on UniLM and Word Vector Adjustment Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This study proposes a universal solution based on UniLM (Unified Language Model) and word vector adjustment algorithm to address the high computational complexity and poor model generalization ability of traditional methods in solving applied mathematical problems. Firstly, utilizing UniLM’s multitasking capabilities to handle complex language structures enhances the model’s understanding of mathematical problems. Next, the word vector adjustment algorithm is introduced to dynamically reinforce mathematical terms, in order to improve the model’s ability to accurately capture key mathematical concepts. In addition, the data has been standardized, including tagging and feature extraction, to ensure that the model can efficiently process input data. The experimental results show that the accuracy of this method is significantly improved on different types of mathematical problems, with accuracy rates of $\mathbf{9 5. 2 \%}$ and $\mathbf{9 0. 5 \%}$ for addition and subtraction problems, respectively. At the same time, it has high computational efficiency and generalization ability, indicating that the proposed method has obvious advantages in solving mathematical problems and is expected to provide new solutions and practical references for this field.

articleTitle: Research on the Recognition Algorithm for the Presence of Occlusion in Face Images based On DDPM
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of AI, face recognition technology has made great progress. However, there are still many challenges and problems with face recognition in complex environments. Especially in the era after the new crown, new viruses appear from time to time, and wearing masks has become a daily need for people. Masks obscure the key features of the face, and traditional face recognition technology cannot correctly recognize faces in access control systems, time and attendance systems, and security systems. Therefore, it is very meaningful to study how to recover the masked face image into a real image without mask, which is helpful to improve the accuracy of face recognition. In this article, for the research of local occlusion face recognition technology, we propose the face image restoration technology based on the diffusion model to remove glasses and masks, which solves the problem of effectively restoring the details of the face under the large-area occlusion. Finally, the restored face is input into Resnet network to achieve the purpose of face recognition. The experiment proves that the use of diffusion model denoising face can effectively improve the accuracy of recognition.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Road Traffic Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Road traffic prediction provides dynamic directions and information for traffic management, improves road safety, forecasts traffic flow density, and fosters effective driving arrangements. Traffic flow forecasting is essential for urban development. Therefore, intelligent traffic management systems are increasingly being utilized by transportation planners and government agencies to plan for informed construction projects. The challenges posed by temporal and spatial dependencies in traffic flow prediction are further compounded by limitations in monitoring equipment. To address these challenges, Machine Learning (ML) and Deep learning (DL) techniques are employed in road traffic prediction, allowing for the handling of both historical and actual time information. This integration enhances the accuracy of traffic forecasts by studying both historical data and real-time trends. The ML and DL techniques deployed in road traffic prediction include Support Vector Regression (SVR), Logistic Regression (LR), Random Forest algorithm, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Auto Regressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network classifier (CNN), and Cross-Modality CNN (CM- CNN). This survey analyses methodologies and advancements in road traffic prediction, contributing to the development of improved traffic management systems.

articleTitle: Identifying Corporate Financial Fraud using Pearson Universal Kernel function-based Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Corporate Financial fraud has significantly affected the endurable development of the financial industries as the critical issue globally. However, it is slightly difficult to determine the frauds with significantly imbalanced datasets due to the rate of non-fraud industries which is too maximum as compared to the fraudulent ones. An intelligence financial statement fraud detection system has significantly developed to help the decision-making for the stakeholders. Therefore, this research proposes the Pearson Universal Kernel function-based Support Vector Machine (PUK-SVM) approach for Identifying corporate financial fraud. A PUK kernel is highly significant at handling nonlinear relationships in data, designing it well-appropriated for the challenging financial data where fraud patterns. The pre-processing step like Min-max normalization approach is performed for normalize the input data from the collected financial data. The Word-to-Vector (Word2Vec) approach is utilized for the feature extraction process from the pre-processed data. Finally, the proposed PUK-SVM approach is utilized to perform into binary classification such as fraud and non-fraud. The experimental outcomes demonstrates that the proposed PUK-SVM method attains the better accuracy result of 96.39% respectively as compared to the existing approaches like SVM and K Nearest Neighbour (KNN).

articleTitle: Intelligent Auditing System Based on Deep Belief Network Density based Spatial Clustering of Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, as the traditional manual audit systems disposed to errors and frequently focused on compliance, rather than risk valuation the need of advanced audit systems had increased. Additionally, increased complex financial transactions, advanced technologies and regulators requirements in sectors and industry firms have necessitated the developing intelligent audit systems. The existing methods for developing intelligent audit systems failed in providing valuable indicators for audit process. Therefore, this paper proposes Deep Belief Network (DBN) - Density Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) for designing an intelligent audit system by detecting fraudulent firms. Initially, audit data dataset is taken which incorporated audit data information of various firms. The collected audit data is preprocessed by utilizing data cleaning and feature engineering, for obtaining efficient financial audit data. Then this financial audit data features are extracted by employed DBN method for revealing hidden patterns. The extracted relevant features are evaluated for detecting the fraudulent firms by utilizing DBSCAN data mining method. The proposed DBN-DBSCAN achieved better results which comprises accuracy (96.58%), Specificity (97.85%), Sensitivity (95.69%), and F1-score $\mathbf{(9 5. 2 0 \%)}$ when compared with existing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM).

Author Keywords: density based spatial clustering of applications with noise

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Detection of High Voltage Electrical Equipment using Multiclass Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent times, condition-based monitoring of power systems has grown in significance to guarantee the dependable and effective functioning of various types of High Voltage Equipment (HVE). However, the degree of Partial discharge detection of high voltage electrical equipment can vary from mild to severe. As a result, this research has presented Multi-class Support Vector Machine (MSVM) technique that provides a dependable means of electrical system monitoring for minimizing the probability of failure. Initially, when high-voltage equipment works, data gathering devices record signals from the equipment in real time. Ultrasonic testing is discover to select high-frequency sound waves that are brought on by protecting fractures. It is a flexible instrument for identifying different PD issues in intricate electrical equipment because of its components’ capacity to handle a wide range of classes. The discharge signals are classified using the designated MSVM in order to correctly identify various types of faults. According to the results, it illustrated that when compared to existing models which includes Multilayer Multifunction Electrical (MME), Stacking Ensemble Neural Network (SENN), and Partial Discharge of Switchgear Detection (PDSD) the proposed methodology achieved better accuracy of $\mathbf{99. 61 \%}$ respectively.

Author Keywords: multi- class support vector machine and ultrasonic testing

articleTitle: Recommendation System using XLNet and Graph based Reinforcement Learning for Japanese Language Teaching with Digital Resources
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In today’s world, digital resources play a crucial role in the sector of language education, offering interactive sessions. In Japanese language teaching, digital resources such as multimedia content, apps, and virtual classrooms are employed rapidly to overcome the challenges such as complex Japanese writing systems, such as kanji, and handling cultural nuances within digital platforms and diverse learning requirements to improve language acquisition. This paper suggests a novel approach technique using various algorithms at each stage. The data is collected from Ilmjapanese-dataset. The collected data is fed as input to the XLNet transformer for processing of data since it has the ability to effectively analyse the text data and then the processed data is converted to vector using word2 vec technique. The overall data is transformed to graphical format and to enhance the overall system Graph Attention Networks v2 (GATv2) is incorporated to overcome the limitation of static attention models and in the end graph based reinforcement learning (GRL) is employed for developing a recommendation model for Japanese language teaching. The XLNet-GRL resulted with higher results with accuracy of 97.58 %, Specificity of 96.85 %, Sensitivity of 98.69 %, and F1 Score of 96.20%.

articleTitle: Implementation of Full Adder Logic using XOR-XNORLogic
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Advances in Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) scaling techniques have led to the proliferate usage of multimedia devices such as laptops, mobiles, graphic cards, personal digital assistants etc. In all these applications, the low power, low die size and high speed fundamental adder architectures are essential. Various algorithms such as fast-fourier, discrete cosine transforms and inverse discrete cosine transform are used. To implement these algorithms, adders with enhanced performance features such as low area and high speed computation are vital and necessary. Several adder architectures are available for different applications. In this paper, a ten transistor using CMOS Exclusive OR and Exclusive NOR gates in combination is proposed. The full adder logic circuit is designed and simulated in cadence virtuoso too environment and operated a dc voltage of 1.5 V in 0.09 micrometer process technology. The proposed ten transistor full adder logic circuit on an average operates at 14 percent less power when compared to the conventional CMOS logic full adder circuit. The propagation delay performance was also slightly better when compared to previous circuit. Both the full adder logic simulations have been carried for multiple dc voltages and performance analysis (i.e. power delay product) has been carried out at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: An English Translation Quality Evaluation based on Generative Adversarial Network and Naive Bayes Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In this era, English translation technologies have gained extensive popularity in today’s globalized, transforming daily communication and the translation industry by breaking text and enabling efficient cross-lingual information exchange. However, English translation technologies often struggle to understand the context, leading to potential misinterpretation of visual content. To overcome these issues proposed a classification model of Naive Bayes classifier. The method commences with the gathering input text data from the Cycle Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) dataset, then the relevant features are extracted through Asymmetric GAN it discriminately identifies the English language related text. Then the classification is done through the Naive Bayes classifier. The proposed method effectively identifying high-quality translations is subsequently trained on these extracted features, allowing it to identify English into distinct quality categories. From the results, the proposed Naive Bayes classifier model showed improved results in contrast to existing impact learning by providing metrics values of Peak Signal-To-Noise Ratio (PNSR) with 78.98 decibels (dB) and Structural Similarity Index Measure (SSIM) with value 0.95 respectively compared with Ghosting and star GAN.

articleTitle: Sine Cosine based Zebra Optimization Algorithm with Support Vector Machine for Credit Card Fraud Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: As credit card usage grows due to its efficiency and easy-to-use facilities, the risk of fraud and misuse has also risen. Processing the huge amount of data generated has become a challenge, leading to unbalanced and high-dimensional datasets, which impacts the performance of the model. Therefore, this research proposes a Sine Cosine-based Zebra Optimization Algorithm with Support Vector Machine (SCZOA-SVM) for classifying Credit Card Fraud Detection (CCFD). The adaptive search efficiency allows exploration in search space by capturing fine-grained patterns thereby SCZOA enhances robustness and accuracy in CCFD. Also, in SCZOA, the dynamic modifications in search parameters help to adapt in determining fraud patterns that enhance detection accuracy. The optimal combination of selected features is fed into the SVM classifier to classify data into fraud and normal transactions. Overall, the SCZOA-SVM achieves better performance in identifying fraudulent transactions by accomplishing the CCFD process effectively. The SCZOA-SVM achieves a better accuracy of ${9 9. 9 7 \%}$, recall/sensitivity of $s{9 8. 1 8 \%}$, precision of ${9 8. 2 7 \%}$, f1-score of ${9 8. 2 2 \%}$ and specificity of 99.97% which is better when compared to Support Vector Data Description (SVDD).

Author Keywords: sine cosine based zebra optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Optimizing Agricultural Productivity: A Machine Learning-Based Approach for Precision Crop Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Agriculture serves as the cornerstone of India’s economy and employment landscape. However, a significant challenge faced by Indian farmers is the lack of optimal crop selection for their soil, leading to reduced productivity and economic strain. This issue has exacerbated food shortages and contributed to a distressing increase in farmer suicides. To address this, recommending suitable crops based on soil characteristics is crucial. Modern agricultural practices emphasize the need for analyzing soil nutrients, such as potassium, nitrogen, and phosphorus, to mitigate deficiencies and enhance crop growth. Moreover, diversifying crop varieties through experimentation is essential for sustainable farming. Aiming to empower farmers with informed decisions, this paper explores various predictive models, including Navies Bayes, Decision Tree, Bagging, Random Forest with the accuracy of 98% to determine the most effective approach for crop prediction based on soil attributes.

articleTitle: Integrated VGG19 and Gated Recurrent Unit with Cosine Similarity Metric for Content based Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Technological advancement has provided huge databases for different genres of image to obtain efficient visual information to satisfy users. The existing algorithms tried to extract the important feature vector from the images to analyze the similarities between the query image and dataset image but failed to reach their expected results. The noises generated during model training, overfitting and gradient vanishing problems are the problems faced by the existing models. To overcome the problems of the existing methods, the VGG19 and Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) with cosine similarity are proposed for content-based image retrieval. The z-score normalization technique was used to standardize the intensity of the images which enhanced the training of the model. The VGG19 algorithm extracted spatial features and the GRU model extracted the temporal features from both database and query images. The cosine similarity metric was used for calculating the similarities of both the images and retrieved based on the feature vector similarities. The proposed VGG19 and GRU with cosine similarity metric has obtained a better average precision of 98.89% for Corel 1 K dataset and 84.90% for Corel 10 K dataset compared to the existing Hybrid Graph-based Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (HGGLCM) model.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers and Particle Swarm Optimization based Evaluation of Oral Function in Preschool Teachers
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Preschool teachers play a vital role in shaping young students’ basic skills and knowledge. Oral communication has aspects like clarity, tone, voice, etc. If early identification of the oral function doesn’t happen, young children might face challenges in communication like pronunciation, clarity, and tone. To overcome these issues this paper and develop a model for automatic evaluation system for oral function of preschool teachers proposed a Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BERT) with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) for feature selection, efficiently achieving better accuracy. Initially, the process begins with data collection using classroom vocal interaction and engagement in an inclusive preschool named cohort that contains data in audio format. Then, the audio data is preprocessed using noise reduction, and further by incorporating the Natural Language Preprocessing (NLP) technique namely Hidden Markov Model (HMM) the audio data is converted into text data. Then, the converted text data performs feature selection using a Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers (BERT) which selects the relevant features like pitch, frequency, voice, tone, etc. from the converted text. Later, Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) is used as an optimization technique that optimizes the selected features and gives optimal solutions. The proposed model acquired greater results with an accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: Bharatanatyam Mudra Classification using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: India is the home of ancient art and one of the few nations in the world with a rich and varied cultural heritage. State by state variations exist in the nation’s languages, dances, and music.In the current technological era, there are various methods for learning these dances. The majority of people pick up the dance by going to classes. However, this method of learning is not accessible to those who are Deaf/Dumb or who choose to learn on their own. This research uses convolutional neural networks (CNNs) to provide a unique way of classifying Bharatanatyam mudras, which are complex hand movements that are essential to the Indian traditional dance style Bharatanatyam.The trained model using EfficientNetB2 architecture has shown strong performance with a test accuracy of 94 percent, indicating its effectiveness in classifying images compared to Resnet50. This study highlights the applicability of contemporary technology in maintaining and comprehending cultural history, contributing to the nexus between deep learning and traditional art forms.

articleTitle: Design of Bandpass Filter at 3 GHz for S-Band Radar Application
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Bandpass filters play a crucial role in S-band radar systems, commonly used for military surveillance, weather monitoring, and other radar applications. These filters enhance signal clarity by suppressing unwanted frequencies while allowing desired signals to pass through. Designing a high-performance filter within the $2-4 \mathrm{GHz}$ range, specifically at 3 GHz, is challenging due to trade-offs between return loss, insertion loss, and bandwidth. Achieving a design that balances these parameters is critical for optimal radar functionality. This paper presents the design of a 3 GHz bandpass filter using an FR4-epoxy substrate with a 200 MHz bandwidth. A lumped element circuit was developed and later converted into a microstrip layout to facilitate precise fabrication. Electromagnetic simulations were conducted to evaluate the filter’s performance. The filter was designed using the Chebyshev approximation to minimize insertion loss and optimize the sharpness of the roll-off. ADS (Advanced Design System) simulation software was employed to validate the performance, focusing on achieving a return loss of $\mathrm{- 1 0} \mathrm{dB}$ or better across the passband. The design achieved minimal insertion loss and satisfactory return loss across the passband, demonstrating its effectiveness for radar applications. Comparative analysis with existing literature further validates the proposed design’s superior performance.

articleTitle: An Online Teaching of Ideological and Political Education using Contrastive Learning with Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In this era, the integration of ideological and political education into college English courses is essential for evolving the social responsibilities and characteristic behaviors of students. Previous researchers have developed several systems using traditional methods but still there are challenges in engaging learners, particularly in online settings. Also, with the COVID-19 pandemic effect the impact of e-learning among different sectors of people has played a crucial and has provided assistance in maintaining interaction, engagement, and personalized support. To overcome such scenarios and challenges, this paper suggests an interactive online teaching system designed to enhance involvement and comprehension of ideological and political concepts within English education. The motive of this approach is to robust, engaging environment that fosters deeper student connection with course content and promotes critical thinking skills essential for ideological and political discourse. Hence, advanced deep learning (DL) techniques are utilized such as Contrastive learning (CL) at the preprocessing stage and Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (Bi-LSTM) for real-time speech recognition and interactive system development. The developed system has resulted with spectacular output of 96.89% with real-time insights and responsive feedback.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Macroeconomic Forecasting Model Based on Time Series Clustering Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The current macroeconomic forecasting models cannot be fully applicable to all economic phenomena, and manual analysis is also difficult to comprehensively consider multiple factors. To address this issue, this article collected and preprocessed macroeconomic data, used a vector autoregression (VAR) model to process time series data, and calculated the Euclidean distance to measure the similarity between economic variables. Based on time series clustering analysis, input the clustering results into the model to predict future macroeconomic variables. Research has found that the correlation between GDP growth and multiple economic variables exhibits significant differences over specific time periods. The average absolute deviation (MAD) between the predicted Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and the actual GDP by the model is less than 650.6 billion yuan. This article demonstrates that macroeconomic forecasting models based on time series clustering analysis can improve decision-making accuracy and contribute to promoting economic stability and development.

articleTitle: Road Accident Detection using MobileNetv2 with Gradient Boosting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: An increased number of vehicles on the roads increases the risk of accidents and eventually resulted huge loss of lives and property. Accident detection utilizing computer vision in much consideration as of late. The existing methods for accident detection gave inaccurate detection due to the errors in sensors and cameras may not capture all angles or all areas. Therefore, this paper proposes MobileNetV2-Gradient Boosting (MNGB) for detection of road accidents which effectively gave accurate detections. Firstly, all videos are split up into smaller shots according to scene changes and then key frames are extracted from each shot based on consecutive frames. This images are augmented by using Kalman filter which reduced the noise and artifacts in images, accurately tracks the objects across frames. Then, features are extracted by using Multi-Scale Network (MSNet) where it extracts the features at various scales by capturing both local and global information. After that, these features were classified by using proposed MNGB which enables the real time processing and reduces the computational resources and gave accurate detection results. The proposed MNGB for road accident detection achieved better results in terms of accuracy $95 \%$, precision ${9 8 \%}$ and F1-Score of ${9 6 \%}$ when compared with existing YOLOv3.

articleTitle: Runways Detection from Sentinel Images using Enhanced Yolov8 Model
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Automation is what future is looking for. Aircrafts and autonomous vision-based vehicles are facing challenging consequences during take-off and landing due to the inefficient detection of runways. The ability to accurately detect airport- runways is critical for enhancing the safety and efficiency of airport-operations. Traditional methods for runway-detection are based on edge-detection or thresholding methods that segment the image by converting pixel intensity thresholds to binary values. Such methods often struggle during undesirable weather conditions and obstructions. The integration of YOLOv8, has shown significant promise in overcoming these challenges. This work enlightens the usage of enhanced YOLOv8 model with better preprocessing techniques for accurate detection of airport- runways. This automated way of detecting the runways will be beneficial during natural calamities, when manual verification is impossible. The proposed model is tested on 880 images and gave the accuracy of 93.2 and false positive rate of 6.32 ensuring the reliability of the model.

articleTitle: Tourist Attraction Passenger Flow Prediction System using Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit with Hermit Crab Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In this era, tourism plays a vital role in economic growth and development of the location, but the increasing number of visitors at popular destinations often leads to environmental degradation and overcrowding. So, the predictive model need to balance tourism’s economic benefits and also preservation of natural and cultural sites results in both visitor satisfaction and conservation efforts. However, predicting tourist flow is challenging due to the numerous factors such as weather conditions, economic fluctuations, and social media trends. This paper suggests a novel approach using different combination of techniques at each stage. At pre-processing stage, data normalization and data cleaning is incorporated for scale and mitigation of irrelevant data. Then the processed data is trained using Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) with Bidirectional Convolutional Neural Network (BiCNN) for capturing sequential temporal and complex data. In the end, Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) with Hermit Crab Optimizer (HCO) is employed for effective prediction of Tourist Attraction Passenger Flow. Hence, the overall system is evaluated and resulted with a greater accuracy of 97.89% when compared to the existing model namely Multiple Attention Deep Neural Network (MADNN) respectively.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Based Bird Census System
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Birds play a vital role in connecting nature and life, serving as key indicators of Earth’s biodiversity. Recent research indicates that global warming, climate change, and pollution significantly impact living creatures. Understanding migratory bird behavior is essential for studying ecology. Among the bird sanctuaries of Karnataka, the population of birds in Rangana Thittu, Kokkare Bellur, and Kaggaladu, each of which is officially known as a wildlife refuge, is recorded for migratory reasons with regular bird censuses. Producing exhaustive headcounts using photographs is a skill that is difficult but absolutely vital for ecologists. Through true-to-life shots taken at various bird havens, this project is working on Artificial intelligence (AI) enabled bird counting. We hope that by using Faster Region-based Convolutional Neural Network (Faster RCNN) and YOLOv5 to count birds, we can get to a stage where the two systems are at least as accurate and efficient as traditional counting methods. The experimental results demonstrate YOLOv5 performs well compared to Faster RCNN. This novel method provides an invaluable insight into our avian ecology, helping to unravel their relationships within ecosystems and contributing towards the conservation of biodiversity.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of University Library Management System Based on Hash-Based Technique and K-Nearest Neighbours-Collaborative Filtering
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, Big data technology increased tremendously that helped libraries in improving their services by providing insights into user behaviour and needs. These technologies improved personalized recommendations and enhanced digital collections in university libraries but managing the university library system also important. The existing methods for library management system failed in recommending useful books to users that resulted with decreased transactions of library. Therefore, this paper proposes Hash-Based Technique and K-Nearest NeighboursCollaborative Filtering (HBT-KNN-Collaborative Filtering) method for application of university library management system based on book recommendations. The proposed method employed on open library dataset that incorporates university library books data. Then, this data is pre-processed by using min-max scaling normalization for scaling all data values into similar ranges. These pre-processed data is mined using HBT for generating association rules. Finally, recommendation of books is done by using KNN-Collaborative Filtering which analysed K-neighbours for efficient high rated and frequently borrowed books recommendation. The proposed HBT-KNNCollaborative Filtering achieved better results in terms of support (16.28%) and confidence (69.58%) Score when compared with existing apriori algorithm.

articleTitle: Structuring a Renewable Energy System Powered Retail Hub using Pvsyst Software
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving urban landscapes, commercial edifices are sprouting up like wildflowers each passing day. The commercial sectors bear substantial loads that devour vast amounts of electrical energy, a demand that can be met with the help of green sustainable energy sources. Grid-connected renewable energy systems (RES) are ideally tailored for both residential and commercial complexes. This paper envisions a RES-powered retail hub with a real-time load capacity of 1547 kW situated in Trichy, where 10% of its daily energy demand, corresponding to 280 kWp, is fulfilled by a solar photovoltaic system. The innovative integrated PV system for the proposed commercial building has been meticulously crafted using PVsyst software. Pvsyst adeptly simulates the specified load and determines the necessary solar power to meet that demand. The simulation outcomes reveal that a PV module configuration of $50 \times 17$ strings with a tilt angle of 10.5° is essential to meet the overall energy needs, achieving a performance ratio of $\mathbf{8 0. 6 \%}$. The resulting system operates at an efficiency of $\mathbf{1 8. 1 2 \%}$.

articleTitle: Efficient Resource Provisioning in Fog Computing Using Agent-Based Contract Net Protocol: A Smart Healthcare Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In the era of pervasive computing, fog computing has emerged as a paradigm that extends cloud services to the edge of the network, enabling real-time data processing and reducing latency for time-sensitive applications, particularly in the Internet of Things (IoT). However, fog computing faces significant challenges in resource allocation and provisioning due to its limited resources. Efficient resource provisioning in fog nodes is critical, as a well-designed algorithm can significantly reduce response time and energy consumption for application requests. In this paper, we present a novel agent-based resource provisioning algorithm tailored for fog computing environments, utilizing the Contract Net Protocol (CNP) to dynamically allocate tasks to virtual machines (VMs) based on resource availability and task requirements. A smart healthcare case study shows the proposed algorithm reduces network usage by ${2 2. 9 5 \%}$ over SJF and $28.67 \%$ over FCFS, reduces energy consumption by $6 \%$ for both SJF and FCFS, and decreases loop delay by $19 \%$ over SJF and $38.48 \%$ over FCFS.

articleTitle: Models of Internet of Things Detection System for Translation Based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Traditional English translation Internet of Things (IoT) detection systems only translate a large amount of text data, ignoring the emotional information of the text data to a certain extent, resulting in poor detection performance of the system. To improve the detection effect, the study first analyzed the characteristics of the English translation of IoT, and then adopted a method based on deep learning. In this method, the TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) model is combined for text feature extraction. Through this technology, the system can more effectively extract key information from large amounts of text data. The experimental results showed that the model proposed in this article can effectively improve the performance of English translation IoT detection. The system achieved an average recognition accuracy of 88.78% and an average translation sentiment similarity of $\mathbf{8 9. 9 4 \%}$ during the testing process. It can be widely applied in English translation IoT detection systems, providing a certain reference for relevant researchers, thereby improving the efficiency and quality of English translation IoT detection.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Management of Building Energy System using Random Forest with Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent days, the energy consumption in buildings has produced with the effect of environmental caused including air and noise pollution. In previous, for the consumption of building energy several methods are utilized such Artificial Neural Network (ANN). However, the existing ANN model suffers dimensionality and takes more time for training. In this paper, a Machine Learning (ML) based Random Forest with Particle Swarm Optimization (RF-PSO) is proposed for the optimizing the management of building energy system. With PSO hyper parameter tuning the proposed RFPSO models dimensionality is reduced with less training time. Initially, the data is taken from Building Data Genome Project 2 (BDGP2) dataset and then preprocessed with min-max scalar, z-score normalization. After that, the preprocessed data is further processed through RF for classification to classify residential or non-residential energy consumptions. Next, the PSO algorithm is used to select the optimum hyper parameters of RF classification to validate the testing dataset. From the results, the proposed RF-PSO model produces outstanding results by achieving 2.20 of MAE, 2.80 of RMSE, and 0.66 of $R^{2}$ respectively, when compared to existing Support Vector Machine (SVM) model.

articleTitle: Simulation Construction of Smart Cloud Platform under the Background of Big Data in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The application of big data (BD) technology in the field of education is becoming increasingly widespread, and smart education (SE) cloud platforms are an important way to achieve smart education. This article helping school managers grasp the learning status and teaching effectiveness of students. The data analysis and visualization module of this article used BD analysis methods to mine and analyze student learning data, and identify learning patterns and trends from it; the data visualization interface was designed to display the analysis results in a graphical manner, making it easier for teachers and students to understand the learned content. The average learning time of the smart education cloud platform group was 10 hours, with an average learning achievement of 90 points and a learning efficiency of 9 points per hour. Under the background of BD in the networking of cultural relics, the smart education cloud platform can improve the learning effectiveness of students and further enhance teaching efficiency.

articleTitle: Optimization Simulation of Landscape Spatial Pattern Gradient Based on Second Class Survey Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Traditional landscape spatial pattern research often lacks comprehensive dynamic analysis capabilities and optimization design support, which limits its effectiveness in practical applications. To solve this problem, this article uses second-class survey data, combined with key factors such as landscape type, shape, and edge ratio, and uses computer technology to simulate and optimize the landscape spatial pattern. This method not only enhances the dynamic analysis capability of landscape space, but also provides effective optimization solutions for different types of landscapes. By conducting in-depth analysis of the second-class survey data in the research area, we can gain a more accurate understanding of the current status and evolutionary trends of landscape space. The research results show that after applying this method, the diversity index of landscape spatial pattern can reach 9.5, indicating that the optimized landscape has higher diversity and ecological value. This optimization method based on secondclass survey data analysis can effectively improve the overall quality and user experience of landscape space. And it provides scientific basis and innovative strategies for future landscape planning and design.

articleTitle: Quantum Filter based CNN for Improved Thyroid Nodule Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The need for accurate and early detection of thyroid nodules has become increasingly critical due to the rising incidence of thyroid cancer. This study presents an innovative automated system that leverages a quantum-inspired convolutional neural network to enhance the classification accuracy of thyroid nodules in ultrasound images. Traditional methods face challenges with limited datasets and complex feature extraction, which this research aims to overcome. By employing a quantum filter transformation, the proposed model extracts detailed and meaningful features from the ultrasound images, which are then processed by a classical neural network for classification. The system differentiates between benignant and malevolent nodules and further categorizes the nodules based on their suspicious characteristics. The classification approach delivers a comprehensive assessment of thyroid nodules. These performance metrics significantly outperform existing models, indicating a substantial advancement in thyroid detection and classification technology. The proposed model offers a promising and innovative solution, providing robust support for clinical diagnosis and potentially accelerating the diagnostic process for thyroid cancer. Our experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves an impressive accuracy of 98.59%.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Character Animation using Forced Switching Mechanism based Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Nowadays in China, the character animation industry is new and developing industry which appears in world stage frequently and widely involved and respected by people from the world. Therefore, this research proposes a Forced Switching Mechanism based Arithmetic Optimization Algorithm (FSMAOA) with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for generating character animation. The FSMAOA is used for feature selection which is applied to escape local optima and enhancing the balance among global and local search. Then, the CNN is used for generating character animation which recognize and acquire the spatial and textural features of characters in images. The collected data is preprocessed by using min-max normalization which is used to standardize each image based on minimum and maximum values. The FSMAOACNN performance is measured by using metrics of accuracy, precision, sensitivity and f-measure. The FSMAOA-CNN achieves $\mathbf{9 7. 8 6 \%}$ accuracy, $\mathbf{9 6. 5 8 \%}$ precision, $\mathbf{9 5. 4 2 \%}$ sensitivity and $96.15 \% \mathrm{f}$-measure for the collected dataset.

articleTitle: An Abridged Investigation of Deep-Learning-based Video Crime Detection Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Crime detection in surveillance video represents an essential process to minimize crime activity before it happens. Furthermore, video crime detection systems are essential to prevent harm to private/public property, save the lives of victims, evade all-time strain, and develop a peaceful community. Additionally, these systems can be beneficial in predicting potential terrorist activities. Recently, video crime classification and detection systems dependent on deep learning approaches become an attention-grabbing area of research. This paper has exhibited an abridged investigation of recently prevailing deep learning-based systems for detecting crime activities in surveillance video to automate hazardous events and enable law enforcement organizations to provide efficient steps toward public safety. A comparative analysis, commonly utilized benchmark crime datasets, and evaluation metrics are presented in this investigation. Moreover, an implementation of effective deep learning approaches is also presented to specify the best systems for the specified application.

Author Keywords: deep learning approaches and video crime detection

articleTitle: An Intelligent Connected Vehicle Path Tracking Control Based on Pure Pursuit Control with Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, autonomous driving developed to cope with expanded domain to improve perception, decision and control over path tracking. The sensor fusion relies on real-time data in various sensors such as cameras, lidar, Global Positioning System (GPS) and radar to make steering adjustments and detect obstacles. However, due to complex driving environment factors such as road curvature, unpredictable obstacles, varying speed and weather conditions which constantly influence vehicle behavior. Due to nonlinear vehicle dynamics impacting tracking errors and lead to errors in localization for multi-sensor data. Therefore, this paper proposes Particle Swarm Optimization- Pure Pursuit Control (PSO-PPC) for vehicle path tracking control. This involves image augmentation techniques to increase sensor data, bounding boxes for spatial tracking through Kalman filter. After that, for feature extraction, Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT) technique is used to local image operator which takes image and collected local feature vector in object recognition. Finally, path tracking average distance between vehicle position and target path is defined by path deviation. Therefore, particle represents potential solution for selection choices or for specific parameters in tracking. The proposed PSO-PPC for vehicle path tracking achieved better results in terms of accuracy ${9 5. 7 2 \%}$, precision ${9 0. 8 7 \%}$ and F1-Score of ${9 8. 7 6 \%}$ when compared with existing Faster-RCNN.

articleTitle: Optimization of Spinal Surgery Robot Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In spinal surgery, the accuracy and stability of path planning are critical to the success of the operation. The traditional path planning method relies on preoperative images and doctor’s experience, which has great uncertainty and risk. To solve this problem, we propose a path planning optimization method for spinal surgery robots based on deep reinforcement learning. By combining deep learning and reinforcement learning algorithms, we built an adaptive path planning model capable of automatically generating optimal surgical paths in complex spinal anatomy. Our model has been extensively tested and validated in both simulated and real surgical Settings, and the results show that the approach outperforms traditional methods in terms of path accuracy, operative time, and safety. In addition, we discuss the adaptability and scalability of the model in different spinal surgery scenarios. Before using deep Q networks in deep reinforcement learning for optimization, the average time for spinal surgery robots to plan the optimal path in 5 surgeries was 6.39 seconds. The average time for the optimized spinal surgery robot to plan the optimal path in 5 surgeries was 2.61 seconds, and the optimized speed was significantly improved. The result can provide a new technical support and solution for spinal surgery.

articleTitle: Analysis of Cell Balancing Techniques for Li-ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Effective cell balancing is crucial for optimizing the performance, lifespan, and safety of lithium-ion batteries in electric vehicles (EVs). This study explores various cell balancing methods, including passive techniques (switching shunt resistor) and active techniques multiple-inductor, flyback converter, and single capacitor), using MATLAB Simulink. The objective is to identify the most efficient method for maintaining balanced cell charge, thereby improving overall battery performance and reliability. Our simulations reveal that active balancing, particularly with the multiple inductor method, achieves faster balancing and higher efficiency compared to passive techniques. This research provides valuable insights into optimizing battery management systems for EVs, highlighting the trade-offs between balancing time, energy efficiency, and system complexity.

articleTitle: Liver Disease Prediction using various Image Processing Techniques and Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Predicting liver disease usually entails estimating a person’s chance of contracting ailments related to the liver using a variety of techniques. The prediction is made using the Novel Decision Tree algorithm and the Naive Bayes algorithm. From CHAOS Grand challenge webpage, data collected for liver images. Decision tree classifiers are compared to Naive Bayes classifiers for their accuracy and precision in diagnosing liver disease in patients. When it comes to predicting liver illness, the Naive Bayes classifier is $75.15 \%$ accurate, whereas the Novel Decision tree classifier is $80.03 \%$ accurate. 0.022 is the most significant number. g-power is used to calculate the sample size for two group at 16. The 95 percent alpha value for the g power is 0.05. The prediction of liver disease at early stage achieved by comparing Novel Decision Tree to Naive Bayes, Novel Decision Tree outperforms the latter in terms of precision and accuracy.

articleTitle: Exploring Faster R-CNN Algorithms for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The task of object detection is widely recognised as a prominent challenge in computer vision applications, particularly in the domains of robotics, autonomous vehicles, and augmented reality.
