abstract: Recently, the detection and classification of gastrointestinal disease tract and disorders based on utilizing endoscopic image classification have increased from the biomedical sector. However, the existing classification methods utilized for gastrointestinal classification has limitations where the models face difficulties in distinguishing between certain classes that results in misclassification. To overcome this limitation, a Mayfly Optimization Algorithm based Deep Belief Network (MOA-DBN) for hyper parameter tuning to classify the gastrointestinal disorder accurately. The proposed MOADBN classifies the gastrointestinal diseases effectively with the help of categorical cross entropy for multi-class classification. The mayfly optimization algorithm addresses the limitations of DBN such as sensitive to initialization and complex hyper parameter tuning that enhanced the classification performance. The endoscopy images are acquired and preprocessed to remove noise to improve classification performance. Features with most appropriate information about the gastrointestinal disease are extracted using pre-trained Visual Geometry Group (VGG) model and classified by the proposed MOA-DBN method. Experimental results of the proposed MOA-DBN method achieved accuracy of ${9 8. 8 3 \%}$ which is higher than the existing classification approaches namely Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and Spatial attention Convmixer.

Author Keywords: mayfly optimization algorithm and visual geometry group

articleTitle: Mixture Kernel based Least Square Support Vector Machine for Personality Prediction on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The prediction of the human’s activities and the personality from the social media platforms attains significant growth between the researchers. The statistical data over the human activities represented through the social media platforms is important benefit for the analysis in the predictions of the personalities and other attitudes of the humans. However, the challenges in personality prediction are to introduce effective approach which determines an individual’s personality traits from various behavioural data. Hence, to tackle these issues, this research proposes the Mixture Kernel based Least Square Support Vector Machine (MK-LSSVM) approach for the personality prediction. The utilization of mixture kernels in SVM, enables for modelling the challenging relationships in the data, capturing various types of input features and enhancing the prediction accuracy. The standard datasets such as Essay and Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) are utilized to implement the MK-LSSVM approach. The Term Frequency and Inverse Gravity Moment (TF-IGM) approach is utilized for the feature extraction, which determines the relationship between the feature sets and features from the datasets. The implemented results demonstrates that the MK-LSSVM approach reaches the superior average accuracy of 89.72% and average precision of 0.89 as compared to the CatBoost algorithm.

Author Keywords: social media and term frequency and inverse gravity moment

articleTitle: Trading Auto-bot for Enhanced Financial Decision Making
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This paper develops an automated trading system based on the backtesting of strategies on the Trader’s View platform, which simulates multiple market scenarios. Machine learning models KNN and KNN with PSO is used for backtesting to measure the performance based on risk-adjusted returns, drawdown, and profit consistency. These selections were also incorporated into the Zerodha API using the KNN-PSO model, which can connect with real markets for the automated execution of trades and showed a considerable outperformance in return on investment and risk management. The model in real time was greatly comparable with what had been in the back-tested result, thus evolving accordingly with changing market conditions. This work is promising specially in terms of short term trading for the improvement of profitability and decision-making as an insight for individual traders and institutions and proved by comparing with LSTM and KNN-PSO ensemble model.

articleTitle: Sleep Stage and Sleep Disorder Detection using Spatial and Temporal Attention based Capsule Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Sleep is referred as a cyclic process which is the most important part in human life. The sleep disorder and its stages are observed from time waveforms such as Electroencephalogram (EEG), Electrocardiograms (ECG), and Electromyograms (EMG) while diagnosing patients. However, the existing Deep Learning (DL) based neural network used for multi-modal sleep stage and sleep disorder detection has limitations in decision making that results in inaccurate detection of sleep stage. To overcome this limitation, a Spatial and Temporal Attention based Capsule Network (STA-CapsNet) is proposed for sleep stage and sleep disorder detecting for multimodal waveforms. The proposed CapsNet model with spatial and temporal attention mechanism focuses on informative regions that helps in making decision and classifies the sleep stages accurately. Firstly, the time waveforms are acquired and preprocessed to convert the signals into Red Green Blue (RGB) images for precise classification of sleep disorders. These RGB images are fed to proposed STA-CapsNet model for classifying the six stages of sleep correctly. Experimental results of the proposed STA-CapsNet method achieved accuracy of ${9 6. 8 9 \%}$ which is higher than the existing approaches such as Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and Visual Geometry Group-16 (VGG-16).

articleTitle: A Classification of Inflammatory Bowel Disease using Ensemble Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) is an enduring, intermittent bowel disorder with unidentified mechanism and etiology. It typically contains Ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn’s disease (CD) that are categorized by several bowel ulcers. An impedance phase displaces dynamic development, accumulating susceptibility to exterior pathogens and theoretically leading to neurotic symptoms which encompasses bowel blockade, intestinal tear and liver lesions, with high disability ratio. The existing models have more overfitting, and class imbalance problems. To overcome that, an Ensemble Learning (EL) model such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest and Gaussian Naive Bayes is proposed in this research. Initially, the collected Gene Expression Series 106817 (GSE106817) dataset is preprocessed with Recurrent MultiArray Average (RMA) Normalization and Log2 Data Transformation to eliminate the noises. Next, Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) technique is used to reduce high-dimensional data for selecting optimal features; and finally, the proposed EL model gives a precise rate in detecting and classifying IBD as CD, UC and Healthy controls. The proposed EL model gives better results than the other compared existing methods Random Forest-Support Vector Machine (RF-SVM) in the context of recall, accuracy, f1 score, and precision as 99.38%, 99.75%, 94.72%, and 97.94% respectively.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Deep Learning Based Techniques for Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Over time, the need for cybersecurity has become a need. It consists of the entirety of actions involved in preventing hackers. It prevents the exploitation of not only the data in internet-connected systems but also the hardware and software entities from cyber threats. Deep learning (DL) techniques, with their ability to process vast data and detect complex patterns, offer significant advancements in identifying malware, intrusions, and anomalies. This study reviews various DL models like Deep Belief Networks (DBN), Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) applied to cybersecurity. Our comparative analysis of CNN and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) models reveals LSTM’s superior accuracy in detecting cyber threats, achieving $\mathbf{9 6 \%}$ compared to CNN’s 85%. The results highlight DL’s potential in creating adaptive security systems, though challenges in dataset preparation and model testing persist. Future work should focus on refining these datasets to enhance DL’s efficiency in cybersecurity applications.

articleTitle: Contactless Methods for Monitoring Vital Parameters: Systematic Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The swift progress of contactless technology has yielded substantial benefits for the healthcare industry, namely in non-invasive vital sign monitoring. The COVID-19 pandemic made these developments even more significant because remote and contactless patient care is important for lowering infection risks without sacrificing the provision of basic healthcare services. Several contactless techniques for monitoring vital signs including blood pressure, heart rate, respiration rate, and body temperature are examined in this systematic literature review (SLR), including radar, infrared thermography, camera-based systems, and photoplethysmography (PPG). This study evaluates the effectiveness and dependability of these technologies and considers how they could improve healthcare systems in the future. It does this by examining sixteen important research articles published between 2021 and 2024. In a post-pandemic era, the findings offer important insights into how contactless monitoring systems may develop further, becoming more precise, easily accessible, and effective, eventually changing how healthcare is delivered and enhancing patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Transaction Fraud Detection Using SMOTE Oversampling
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Credit card fraud detection remains a critical challenge in financial transactions, particularly due to the prevalence of unbalanced datasets and the limitations of traditional algorithms. This paper suggests a novel hybrid ensemble approach that reduces false negatives and improves fraud detection accuracy by merging the Random Forest (RF) and XGBoost (XGB) algorithms. Unbalanced data presents challenges for traditional algorithms such as Random Forest, Decision Trees, XGBoost, Logistic Regression, and Deep Neural Networks (DNN). Our hybrid technique, which is enhanced by under-sampling and the Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique (SMOTE), capitalizes on the benefits of RF and XGB while limiting their drawbacks. We prioritize recall over accuracy in order to reduce false negatives, which are important for detecting fraud. With an emphasis on recall, we evaluate the performance of Decision Trees, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, XGBoost, DNN, and our hybrid model. Utilizing techniques to address data imbalance, the evaluation makes use of an actual credit card dataset with different attributes. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of our hybrid ensemble approach in enhancing fraud detection accuracy and reducing false negatives, highlighting its potential for practical application in financial security systems.

articleTitle: Research on Load Forecasting Based on Quantum Genetic Algorithm in Small Living Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This study combines the small ecological environment algorithm with quantum genetic algorithm to predict the electricity load of solar buildings, aiming to improve the accuracy of electricity load prediction by combining the small ecological environment algorithm with quantum genetic algorithm algorithm. And evaluate its performance using two statistical indicators: coefficient of determination ($\mathrm{R}^{2}$) and root mean square error (RMSE). The research results indicate that the small ecological environment algorithm and quantum genetic algorithm have higher prediction accuracy, and small ecological environment optimization significantly improves the prediction accuracy of quantum genetic algorithm, $R^{2}=0.98$, RMSE $=0.12$. In addition, the small ecological quantum genetic algorithm showed excellent convergence, achieving a TIC value of 0.01395 after 121 iterations. This model is significantly better than traditional methods in predicting electricity load.

articleTitle: Applying Graph Neural Networks to ERP Systems with a Focus on Business Centric Development
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Software for enterprise resource planning (ERP) has grown in popularity as a means to streamline corporate processes that are critical for survival in the modern, globalized marketplace. In order to cater to the specific needs of their global customer base in terms of both price and availability, suppliers in the textile industry are under increasing pressure to enhance their manufacturing management practices. This task is becoming more dependent on the careful selection and usage of information technology. Preprocessing, feature extraction, and training are the three phases that make up this method. Time difference relevance and K-L distance are components of preprocessing. The feature selection approach employs Kernel Principal Component Analysis for the factor extraction phase. An GNN was used for the model’s training. The proposed technique outperforms CNN and SVM with an average accuracy of $\mathbf{9 2. 1 6}$ percent.

articleTitle: A Support Vector Machine with Elastic Net Regularization and Radial Basis Function based Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radio Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: In recent years, communication technologies are growing significantly and Cognitive Radio (CR) networks is an expert system to adjust the radio spectrum. However, wireless communication diverse scenarios and distinguishing spectrum occupancy poses a significant challenge in Spectrum Sensing (SS). As it requires high-performance and flexible solutions to accommodate varied characteristics and ensure seamless connectivity. Hence, a Machine Learning (ML) based algorithm namely Support Vector Machine along with Elastic Net Regularization and Radial Basis Function (SVM-ENR-RBF) is proposed to detect and classify spectrum signals. Initially, the spectrum signals are collected from RadioML2016.10b dataset which are preprocessed by Min-Max scaler to normalize Inphase (I) and Quadrature Components (QC) of modulated signals. Finally, SVM classifier provides a regularization technique namely ENR and a kernel function RBF to make easier to analyze as well as classify the spectrum occupancy. The combination of SVM-ENR-RBF improves the detection accuracy, robustness and generalization capabilities. From the results, SVM-ENR-RBF method offers high results of probability of detection, prediction accuracy, and computation time results as $99.8 \%, 99.2 \%$, and 1.6 sec respectively when compared with existing Reinforced Learning-Extreme Learning Machine.

articleTitle: Prediction of River Water Quality Index and Uncertainty Analysis using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)

authors.preferredName: Rana Veer Samara Sihman Brahmatej Rupavath

abstract: The increasing demand for clean water in river systems drives the development of new models for water quality prediction. The problem statement is the need for accurate and reliable prediction of water quality indices in various river basins using machine learning techniques. Through the integration of diverse methodologies in the proposed approach aims to overcome limitations associated with conventional methods and emerging in water quality concerns. The dataset used in Water Quality Prediction (WQP) in the river dataset was used to predict the water quality index. The proposed method in this paper consists of preprocessing, data standardization, and data splitting with the parameter and calculating the WQI. The combined machine learning algorithms include Random Forest (RF), Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGB), and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN). The numerical validation of this paper is an MSE of 0.03, an RMSE of 0.09, an MAE of 0.02, and $R^{2}~\mathbf{0.12}$. The existing methods like Water Quality Management Limitations (WQM-WQI), Sequential Minimal Optimization-Support Vector Machine (SMO-SVM), Principal Quality Analysis (PQA-WQI), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN-WQI) are overcome by the proposed method.

articleTitle: Developing an Assistive System for Dementia Patients using Raspberry Pi and YOLOv5: A Step Towards Improved Quality of Life
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Dementia, a complex mental health issue predominantly affecting the elderly, presents profound challenges including memory loss and difficulty recognizing the family members. With approximately 50 million individuals worldwide affected by dementia and a significant shortage of trained caretakers in India, this paper seeks to address the pressing need for better detection techniques and assistance solutions. This proposed work aims to perform two tasks: primarily, proposed method can diagnose the dementia stage of the patients based on question answer model. and secondarily, to assist the patients with their daily routine work using YOLOv5 which uses CNN (Convolution Neural Network) for face and object detection and recognition with 98.7% accuracy.

articleTitle: Traffic Flow Prediction using Spatiotemporal Fusion with Graph Convolution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Traffic flow prediction is one of the significant component of Intelligent Transportation System (ITS). However, higher-precision of traffic flow prediction particularly in long-term forecast is challenging because of complex spatial-temporal dependencies in traffic data. Therefore, this research proposes a Spatiotemporal Fusion with Graph Convolution Network (SF-GCN) for traffic flow prediction. The SF-GCN effectively capturing both spatial and temporal dependencies in traffic data thereby leveraging graph structures to represent spatial relationship accurately. Moreover, it integrates temporal dynamics that is significant in traffic prediction through spatiotemporal fusion which enables to understand changes in traffic flow patterns. The SF-GCN delivers accurate and robust traffic flow prediction through leveraging spatial-temporal complexity in traffic networks. The metrics such as Root mean square error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) are taken to estimate the SF-GCN performance in traffic flow prediction. The SF-GCN attains MAPE of $10.62 \%$ and $8.21 \%$ for PEMS04 and PEMS08 datasets which is better than Weather interaction-aware Spatio-Temporal Attention Network (WST-ANet).

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Energy Predictive Model for Task Scheduling in Sustainable IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The proliferation of IoT devices has become a worldwide concern due to the rapid growth and integration of smart technologies across various industries and consumer applications. Thus, the demand for sustainable IoT has remained in the top interest of designers. Power consumption optimization is the most critical factor affecting the design of sustainable computing architectures in IoT devices, necessitating the implementation of task scheduling techniques. In this manuscript, an energy predictive framework has been presented for task scheduling operations in sustainable IoT devices. The proposed model has been developed using Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network. Additionally, Single Spectrum Analysis (SSA) technique has been incorporated to improve the prediction accuracy. The model has been trained using real-time data. It predicts harvestable solar energy possessing Mean Absolute Error (MAE) as low as 0.001664 and Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.002749, outperforming benchmark DL networks.

articleTitle: Zebra Optimization Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Network for Detecting Subtle Changes in Skin Pigmentation for Melanoma Screening
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Melanoma is easily detectable by visual examination since it occurs on the skin surface. Traditionally approach inefficiently to capture to diagnosis, it need to facilitate the diagnosis process while still yielding an accurate of diagnosis. This paper, Zebra optimization Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Network (ZOA-CNN) combined to performed in the classification skin pigmentation for melanoma screening achieve better accuracy. The ZOA is used to optimize the CNN technique enhance the classification accuracy. ZOA balances exploration as well as exploitation that supports the CNN avoid local minima and attain best solutions at the time of training. This flexibility enhances the robustness of the model in detecting melanoma. Initially data obtained from the ISIC 2019 dataset and pre-processing involved the Histogram Equalization and Convert RGB images to grayscale images, which is enhance the image quality. Segmentation utilized U-net architecture includes skip connections that allow high resolution feature from the encoder and decoder path. Feature extraction using MobileNet is designed for efficiency to extracted the high level feature and depthwise separable convolutions reduces the amount of parameters while maintaining the performance. The performance of proposed model evaluated the various metrics and it attains the better accuracy of 0.91 compared to GoogleNet.

Author Keywords: u-net architecture and zebra optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Securing Networks: Leveraging Machine Learning for Enhanced DDoS Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The growing complexity of Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks poses a serious threat to network security, making the development of effective detection and mitigation techniques essential. This study tackles this issue by introducing a novel approach that utilizes machine learning (ML) to improve the identification of DDoS attacks using realworld datasets. By leveraging the CSE-CIC-IDS2018 AWS dataset, we develop a strong classifier to examine network traffic patterns that suggest potential DDoS activity. Our approach encompasses comprehensive steps, including data collection, preprocessing, and the deployment of sophisticated ML algorithms. The outcomes reveal impressive performance, with the model achieving a $99.98 \%$ accuracy rate and nearperfect precision and F1 scores. These results highlight the strength of neural network-based models, especially when implemented using advanced frameworks such as Keras. This research ultimately bolsters network defenses against DDoS attacks and emphasizes the necessity of ongoing innovation in detection techniques to protect digital resources and maintain uninterrupted online services in our increasingly digitalized environment.

articleTitle: Style Transfer in 3D Object Generation using Generative Adversarial Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: This paper uses style transfer techniques with GANs to improve the variety and quality of generated 3D objects. By outlining the numerous advantages and highlighting the key obstacles, we show that it is feasible to merge style transfer with 3D object generation. It has been shown that GANs, originally thought of in terms of 2D domains, can be easily extended to 3D settings; however, certain issues have been identified with the modeling of 3D shapes and the training of models. Mode collapse and high computational complexity are two of the main obstacles that prevent GANs from being used for 3D objects. Additionally, it clarifies why a distinct and more intricate architecture is necessary to address the issue of 3D gan and neural implicit representations in modeling. Additional emphasis was placed on enhancing training stability through the use of superior methods, such as the progressive growing and WassersteinGANs with gradient penalty method. The study does, however, detail the difficulties of putting these models into practice, as well as some environmentally friendly ways to improve computation, such as by trimming networks and making use of clouds. These are the research vulnerabilities that have been identified: Researchers should expand their focus in their current studies of the aforementioned model to include domains that adapt and transfer learning, and they should also take into account the reality of operating in VR and AR settings. If these holes are filled, we can remove the current limitations and use style transfer to create 3D objects to a far greater extent. So, it’s clear that style transfer intermittently into 3D GANs can work, but there are still a lot of obstacles to overcome and limits to these methods, so researchers are working hard to make them more effective and realistic.

articleTitle: Addax Optimization Algorithm with Convolutional Neural Network for Rheumatoid Arthritis classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) is a very common autoimmune disease that causes significant morbidity and mortality, therefore early diagnosis treatment is important. The RA is an autoimmune illness that affects the musculoskeletal system causing systemic, inflammatory and chronic effects, it becomes decreases physical function causing articular damage and fatigue. This paper proposed Addax Optimization Algorithm (AOA) with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for classification, which is efficiently achieve better accuracy. Initially data obtained from the RA dataset and pre-processing involved the min-max normalization is uniformly the feature vector. The combination of AOA is designed to optimize hyper parameters efficiently which is significantly reduce the high dimensionality and better accuracy in classifying of RA. The classification utilized CNN technique capturing complex patterns in image data effective for analysis the RA image and adaptive approach helps to find the best solution by using optimization approach. The performance of proposed method is evaluated with various metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall and $\mathbf{f 1}$-score metrics on RA dataset.

articleTitle: A Data Governance Method for Power Marketing based on Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Now a days, Power marketing count on data analysis to optimize various operations and decision-makings. However, data quality has various issues, inconsistent formats, and regulatory compliance challenges hinder efficient data management. A data governance method for power marketing ensures data and compliance enabling reliable insights and informed decision-making. To overcome those drawbacks this paper, proposed a method of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) classifier follows a systematic approach to power marketing data governance. Initially, collected and verify input data from the Smart Grid Stability dataset, ensuring a strong foundation for our method. Next, performed feature extraction using SHAP, a technique that identifies the most relevant features in the dataset. Moreover, developed an ANN based classification model that leverages the strengths of both SHAP and ANN to accurately classify and predict outcomes in power marketing data governance. This proposed approach enables reliable insights and informed decision-making, driving efficiency and effectiveness in power marketing strategies. The performance of proposed model evaluated with the various metrics such as ${\mathrm {{R}}}^{2}$ value is of (0.156) Mean Absolute Error (MAE) value (0.121), Mean Squared Error (MSE) error value (${(0. 1 8 9)}$ and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) (0.125) metrics on Smart Grid Stability dataset.

articleTitle: Rescaled Hinge Loss Function based Convolutional Neural Network for Identification of Art Forgery by Image Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: The rapid growth of Information Technology (IT) as well as Computer Science becomes an important evolution in marketable painting applications. The systematic authentication of paintings embraces the implication into the monarchy of art gathering. Performing the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) approach for the identification of the reliable as well as forged painting arts according to the colour images is a feasible but trivial selection. However, this is challenging due to variations in artistic styles, textures, and subtle details which ambiguous forgery detection. Hence, this research proposes the Rescaled Hinge Loss Function based CNN (RHLF-CNN) approach for the identification of art forgery. The RHLF improves the model’s capability to discriminate between genuine and forged artworks, leads to more precise classification. The high-definition and hyperspectral image dataset of Chinese characters is utilized to estimate the effectiveness of the RHLF-CNN approach. The Local Binary Pattern (LBP) approach is used for the feature extraction process. The Chi-square approach is utilized for extracting the relevant features from the extraction process. The experimental results demonstrates that the proposed RHLF-CNN approach attains the better accuracy of 93.16% as compared to the existing approaches like Pulse-Coupled Neural Network (PCNN).

articleTitle: Wireless Radiance: LoRaWAN-Enabled Home Automation System
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Software, Systems and Information Technology (SSITCON)
abstract: Traditional home automation systems face limitations in long-distance control, relying heavily on mobile monitoring applications. The proposed system overcomes it by developing an IoT-based home automation system utilizing LoRaWAN technology. Integrating the REYAX RYLR896 module with ESP8266 and microcontroller, this system enables remote control of appliances with real-time feedback. LoRaWAN’s long-range, low-power communication ensures reliable connectivity, eliminating distance constraints. The system features LED indicators for connectivity monitoring and computes Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and Received Signal Strength Indication (RSSI) for optimal communication reliability. This innovative approach enhances performance, user convenience, and energy efficiency in smart homes. The proposed system provides a reliable, efficient, and user-friendly solution for modern home automation, demonstrating LoRaWAN’s potential for next-generation IoT applications.
